title: It won’t be Trump who kills the ICC
english: The International Criminal Court faces an existential threat from aggressive United States efforts to undermine its authority and shield American citizens from legal accountability. While U.S. political figures have long opposed the court, recent escalations and threats of sanctions have reached a dangerous new level. The survival of the ICC ultimately depends on its member states moving beyond mere words and taking decisive, unified action to defend the institution's independence.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት (ICC) በአሜሪካ መንግስት ከፍተኛ ጫና እና የህልውና ስጋት ተጋርጦበታል። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የራሳቸውን ዜጎች ከተጠያቂነት ለማዳን ፍርድ ቤቱን ለማዳከም እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህንን ፈተና ተቋቁሞ እንዲቀጥል የአባል ሀገራት በቃል ደረጃ ብቻ ሳይሆን በተግባር በመቆም የፍርድ ቤቱን ነፃነት ሊያስከብሩ ይገባል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) irratti weerarri fi dhiibbaan gama mootummaa Ameerikaatiin dhufuun bu'uuruma isaa kanneen balaa irra buuse dha. Ameerikaan lammiilee ishee itti gaafatamummaa irraa oolchuuf jecha mana murtichaatti gubuu fi dadhabsiisuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jirti. Mana murtichis ta'e haqaaf dhaabbachuun kan danda'amu, biyyoonni miseensa ta'an afaan qofaan osoo hin taane, gochaan mana murtichaa akka hin diigamne ittisuun dirqama isaanii bahuu qabu.

title: Women’s Day in South Africa turns 70 with equality still out of reach
english: South Africa is marking the 70th anniversary of the historic 1956 Women's March, where 20,000 women protested against oppressive apartheid-era pass laws. While this demonstration was a powerful milestone for political rights and gender equality, many women in the country still face significant challenges today. Despite the legacy of that brave movement, true equality remains an unfinished goal for millions of South African women.
amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ የ1956ቱን ታሪካዊ የሴቶች ሰልፍ 70ኛ ዓመት በዓል እያከበረች ነው። በወቅቱ 20 ሺህ ሴቶች በአፓርታይድ ዘመን የነበሩ አድሏዊ ህጎችን በመቃወም ድምፃቸውን አሰምተው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ሰልፍ ለሴቶች መብት ትልቅ መነሻ ቢሆንም፣ በሀገሪቱ ያሉ ሴቶች አሁንም ተገቢውን እኩልነት ለማግኘት እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ። የዚያ ታሪካዊ እንቅስቃሴ ውጤት ቢኖርም፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሴቶች ሙሉ እኩልነትን አሁንም አላገኙም።
oromo: Afrikaan Kibbaa waggaa 70ffaa hiriira dubartootaa kan bara 1956, yeroo dubartoonni 20,000 ta'an seera jireenyaa kan yeroo apartheid mormanii turan kabajaa jirti. Hiriirri kun mirga dubartootaaf tarkaanfii guddaa kan ta'e ta'us, har'as dubartoonni biyyattii keessa jiran walqixxummaa argachuuf qormaata guddaa keessa jiru. Duula ija jabinaa sanaa boodas, dubartoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman ammayyuu walqixxummaa guutuu argachuuf hawwa jiru.

title: Flight cancellations, evacuations as China braces for Typhoon Dolphin
english: China is preparing for the arrival of Typhoon Dolphin, which is expected to bring heavy rainfall and dangerous winds to its eastern coast. Authorities have evacuated approximately 500,000 residents from high-risk areas and cancelled over 1,600 flights to ensure public safety. A red alert has been issued as officials brace for potential floods and landslides caused by the severe storm.
amharic: ቻይና በምስራቃዊ የባህር ዳርቻዋ ላይ ከባድ ዝናብ እና ንፋስ የሚያመጣውን የዶልፊን አውሎ ንፋስ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ትገኛለች። የህዝብ ደህንነትን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎች ከአደጋ ተጋላጭ አካባቢዎች የተፈናቀሉ ሲሆን ከ1,600 በላይ በረራዎች ተሰርዘዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአውሎ ንፋሱ ሳቢያ ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ የጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት አደጋዎችን ለመከላከል ከፍተኛ የጥንቃቄ ማስጠንቀቂያ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Chaayinaan obomboleessa 'Dolphin' jedhamu kan baha biyyattii irratti rooba cimaa fi qilleensa humna guddaa qabu fiduu maluuf qophaa'aa jirti. Nageenya ummataa eeguuf jecha namoonni gara walakkaa miliyoonaa ta'an naannoo balaan itti uumamuu danda'u irraa kan qe'eetti deebi'an yoo ta'u, balalliiwwan xiyyaaraa 1,600 ol ta'anis haqamaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa lolaa fi lafti sigigachuu danda'u hordofee balaa mudachuu danda'u ittisuuf akeekkachiisa cimaa dabarsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia says fire extinguished at Aramco facility in Jizan
english: Saudi authorities successfully put out a fire that ignited at an Aramco oil facility in the coastal city of Jizan on Sunday. No injuries occurred during the incident, and officials are currently investigating the situation. The Houthi rebels in Yemen claimed responsibility for the fire, stating they used a drone to strike the refinery in retaliation for recent airspace violations.
amharic: የሳዑዲ ባለሥልጣናት እሁድ ዕለት በጂዛን ከተማ በሚገኝ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ ተነስቶ የነበረውን የእሳት ቃጠሎ መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። በዚህ አደጋ ምንም ዓይነት የሰው ሕይወት አልጠፋም፤ ባለሥልጣናቱም ሁኔታውን እየመረመሩ ይገኛሉ። በየመን የሚገኙት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የነዳጅ ማጣሪያውን በድሮን እንደመቱት በመግለጽ የጥቃቱን ኃላፊነት ወስደዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Sa'udii Dilbata darbe magaalaa Jizanitti iddoo suufa qulqulleessu kan Aramco irratti ibidda ka'e dhaamsuuf danda'aniiru. Balaa kana keessatti namni miidhame hin jiru, yeroo ammaa kanattis qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira. Finxaaleyyiin Huthotaa Yemen keessa jiran, weerara kana kan raawwatan immoo iddoo sana darbee darbee qilleensa isaanii cabsuu isaaniitiin walqabatee xiyyaara malee fayyadamuun akka haleelan ibsaniiru.

title: Nagasaki mayor says ‘humanity and nuclear weapons cannot coexist’
english: Nagasaki Mayor Shiro Suzuki recently addressed a memorial ceremony marking the anniversary of the atomic bombing in Japan. He emphasized that the survival of mankind is incompatible with the existence of nuclear weapons. Government officials, including Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, gathered at the Nagasaki Peace Park to commemorate the event.
amharic: የናጋሳኪ ከንቲባ ሽሮ ሱዙኪ በጃፓን የደረሰውን የአቶሚክ ቦምብ ጥቃት መታሰቢያ በዓል ላይ ባደረጉት ንግግር የሰው ልጅ እና የኑክሌር መሳሪያዎች በአንድ ላይ ሊኖሩ አይችሉም ብለዋል። በናጋሳኪ የሰላም ፓርክ በተካሄደው በዚህ ዝግጅት ላይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳናኢ ታካኢቺን ጨምሮ በርካታ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ተገኝተዋል። የዝግጅቱ ዋና ዓላማ የኑክሌር መሳሪያዎች የሚያደርሱትን ጥፋት በማስታወስ ለሰላም ጥሪ ማቅረብ ነው።
oromo: Kantiibaan magaalaa Naagasakii, Shiroo Suzuukii, yaadannoo bokkaa boombii atoomii Jaappaan irratti raawwate irratti haasaa taasisaniin, namootnii fi meeshaaleen nukilaaraa waliin jiraachuu akka hin dandeenye ibsaniiru. Ayyaanni kun paarkii nageenyaa Naagasakii keessatti kan kabajame yoo ta'u, mummichi ministeeraa Saana'ee Taaka'iichii dabalatee aangawaan mootummaa hedduun argamaniiru. Kaayyoon guyyaa yaadannoo kanaa miidhaa meeshaaleen nukilaaraa geessisan yaadachuu fi nageenyaaf dhaadannoo qabatamaa taasisuudha.

title: World number one Sabalenka upset by Alexandrova at Canadian Open
english: World number one Aryna Sabalenka was eliminated from the Canadian Open after a tough three-set defeat by Ekaterina Alexandrova in Toronto. Although Sabalenka fought back to win the second set, Alexandrova maintained aggressive play to secure the victory in the final set. This unexpected loss creates a setback for Sabalenka as she prepares for the upcoming US Open.
amharic: የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ደረጃ ላይ የምትገኘው አሪያና ሳባሌንካ በቶሮንቶ በተካሄደው የካናዳ ኦፕን የቴኒስ ውድድር በኤካተሪና አሌክሳንድሮቫ ተሸንፋ ከውድድሩ ውጪ ሆናለች። ሳባሌንካ ሁለተኛውን ዙር በማሸነፍ ወደ ውድድሩ ለመመለስ ጥረት ብታደርግም፣ በመጨረሻው ዙር አሌክሳንድሮቫ ባሳየችው ጠንካራ ብቃት ለመሸነፍ ተገዳለች። ይህ ያልተጠበቀ ሽንፈት ሳባሌንካ ለሚመጣው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር በምታደርገው ዝግጅት ላይ ተፅዕኖ እንደሚኖረው ተጠቅሷል።
oromo: Ariyana Saabaaleenkaa isheen sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa irra jirtu, dorgommii Kaanaadaa Oopan kan Tooroontoo irratti Ekaterii-naa Aleeksaandroovaan injifatamtee dorgommicha irraa hafteetti. Saabaaleenkaa seetii lammaffaa injifachuun deebitee of haaromsuuf yaaltus, seetii dhumaa irratti Aleeksaandroovaan tapha cimaa taphachuun injifannoo argatteetti. Kufatiin isheen hin yaadamin kun qophii Saabaaleenkaa dorgommii Yuu Es Oopan dhufuuf taasisaa jirtu irratti gufuu ta'eera.

title: Israel announces tender for 627 settler units in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli authorities have issued a formal call for construction bids to build 627 new housing units in the Kochav Yaakov settlement, located in the occupied West Bank. Officials warn that this expansion will further isolate Palestinian communities from Jerusalem and consolidate Israeli control over the area. This project marks a shift from the planning phase to active development, continuing a trend of increased settlement activity seen throughout the first half of 2026.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው የኮቻቭ ያኮቭ ሰፈራ 627 አዳዲስ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ጨረታ አውጥተዋል። ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ይህ መስፋፋት የፍልስጤም ማህበረሰቦችን ከኢየሩሳሌም የበለጠ እንዲገለሉ እና አካባቢውን በእስራኤል ቁጥጥር ስር ለማዋል ያለመ ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ከዕቅድ ወደ ተግባራዊ ግንባታ መሸጋገሩን ያሳያል፤ ይህም በ2026 የመጀመሪያ አጋማሽ የታየውን የሰፈራ መስፋፋት ቀጣይ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qilleensa-Kaaba (West Bank) keessatti, iddoo Kochav Yaakov jedhamutti manneen jireenyaa haaraa 627 ijaaruuf caalbaasii baasee jira. Hojjettoonni mootummaa akka jedhanitti, ijaarsi kun jiraattota Falasxiin magaalaa Yerusaalem irraa fageessuufi to'annoo Israa'el naannicharratti jiru cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha. Sagantaan kun sadarkaa karooraa irraa gara hojiitti ce'uun isaa, waggaa 2026 walakkaa jalqabaa keessa ijaarsi iddoo qubannaa kun jabaatee itti fufee akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Wildfire forces thousands of evacuations in Western Canada
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in Western Canada’s British Columbia province has triggered the evacuation of over 20,000 residents. The fire has consumed roughly 9,500 hectares of land, placing numerous homes and farms in immediate danger. Emergency crews are currently working hard to contain the flames as the situation remains critical.
amharic: በካናዳ ምዕራባዊ ክፍል በብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት የተከሰተ የሰደድ እሳት ከ20,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድዷል። እሳቱ ወደ 9,500 ሄክታር የሚጠጋ መሬት ያወደመ ሲሆን በበርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እና እርሻዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kaanaadaa gama dhihaa, godina Biritiish Kolombiyaa keessatti ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'achaa jiruun namoonni 20,000 ol ta'an iddoo jireenya isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Ibidni kun lafa hektaara 9,500 ta'u barbadeessuun, manneen jireenyaa fi qonna hedduu balaaf saaxileera. Gareen dhaamsitoota ibiddaa haala kanaan dura hin argamin kana to'achuuf halkanii fi guyyaa hojjechaa jiru.

title: Lionel Messi returns to Argentina after father Jorge’s death
english: Football icon Lionel Messi has traveled to his hometown of Rosario, Argentina, following the death of his father and longtime manager, Jorge Messi. Jorge passed away at age 68 after battling a lengthy illness. He played a crucial role in shaping his son's legendary career since he was a young boy.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ሊዮኔል ሜሲ የአባቱ እና የረጅም ጊዜ ወኪሉ የነበሩት ጆርጅ ሜሲ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየትን ተከትሎ ወደ ትውልድ ከተማቸው ሮዛሪዮ፣ አርጀንቲና ተመልሰዋል። ጆርጅ ሜሲ በ68 ዓመታቸው ከረጅም ጊዜ ህመም በኋላ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እርሳቸው ልጃቸው በልጅነቱ ጀምሮ የእግር ኳስ ህይወቱን እንዲገነባ ትልቅ ሚና ተጫውተዋል።
oromo: Leencaa kubbaa miillaa kan ta'e Lionel Messi, abbaan isaa fi gorsaan isaa waggoota dheeraaf tajaajilaa turan Jorge Messi du'aan boqochuu isaanii hordofee gara biyyasaa Arjentiinaa magaalaa Rozaariyootti deebi'eera. Jorge umurii waggaa 68tti dhukkuba dheeraa erga isaan qabee booda du'aniiru. Isaanis ilma isaanii hojiin kubbaa miillaa isaa akka milkaa'uuf ijoollummaa isaa irraa kaasee gumaacha guddaa godhaniiru.

title: Iran issues new demands as Pezeshkian seeks deal
english: Iran has announced six new, stringent conditions that must be fulfilled by the United States before the Strait of Hormuz is allowed to reopen. These requirements include the lifting of economic sanctions, the release of frozen assets, the withdrawal of American military forces from the region, and an end to attacks on Iran and its regional allies. Iranian officials stated that the reopening of this vital waterway is directly tied to Washington meeting these expansive political and military demands.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲከፈት አሜሪካ ማሟላት ያለባት ስድስት አዳዲስ እና ጥብቅ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አስታውቃለች። እነዚህ መስፈርቶች የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን ማንሳትን፣ የታገዱ የገንዘብ ሀብቶችን መልቀቅን፣ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ከቀጠናው እንዲወጡ እና በኢራን እና አጋሮቿ ላይ የሚደረጉ ጥቃቶች እንዲቆሙ ያካትታሉ። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት የባህር መንገዱ መከፈት በቀጥታ ዋሽንግተን እነዚህን ሰፊ የፖለቲካ እና የወታደራዊ ጥያቄዎች ከመቀበሏ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Iraan dhiheenya kana daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan haalawwan jaha kan guutuu qabdu ta'uu beeksisteetti. Haalawwan kunneen keessatti kaayyoon dhaabuu adabbii diinagdee, gadi lakkisuu qabeenya Iraan kan qabame, ba'uu waraana Ameerikaa naannichaa fi dhaabuu weerara Iraan fi michoota ishee irratti godhamu kan dabalatuudha. Hoggantoonni Iraan akka ibsanitti, banamuun daandii galaana kanaa guutumaan guutuutti kan hundaa'e fedhiiwwan siyaasaa fi waraanaa kana Ameerikaan fudhachuu ishee irratti ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Very painful’: Joe Biden’s cancer has spread, son Hunter says
english: Hunter Biden has revealed that his father’s prostate cancer has progressed significantly, spreading to his bones and other areas of his body. The former US president was originally diagnosed with the aggressive condition in May 2025. According to his son, the illness has become extremely painful and has severely impacted the former president's daily physical capabilities.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት የፕሮስቴት ካንሰር ወደ አጥንታቸው እና ወደ ሌሎች የሰውነት ክፍሎቻቸው መሰራጨቱን ልጃቸው ሀንተር ባይደን አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ በግንቦት 2025 በከፍተኛ የካንሰር ህመም መያዛቸው ቢታወቅም፣ አሁን ግን በሽታው ተባብሶ ከፍተኛ ህመም እያስከተለባቸው ይገኛል። ይህ የጤና ሁኔታ በዕለት ተዕለት ህይወታቸው ላይ ከፍተኛ ተፅእኖ እያሳደረ መሆኑንም ልጃቸው ገልጿል።
oromo: Hanter Baayden akka ibsetti, kaansariin piroostateetii abbaa isaa gara lafee fi qaamota biroo irratti babaldhateera. Pirezidantichi duraan baatii Caamsaa bara 2025 kaansarii hamaa kanaan qabamuu isaanii kan beekame yoo ta'u, amma garuu dhukkubichi daran hammaatee fi dhukkubbii cimaa uumaa akka jiru ibsameera. Haalli fayyaa kunis pirezidanticharratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu isaa ilmi isaanii ibseera.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The article criticizes recent U.S. visa restrictions on TPLF leaders, arguing that Washington is prioritizing political convenience over justice for victims of atrocities. The author contends that ignoring accountability for genocide to favor diplomatic pragmatism undermines long-term peace in Ethiopia. By failing to address the underlying violence and the need for truth, these sanctions are viewed as a betrayal of international human rights standards.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በአሜሪካ መንግስት በህወሓት መሪዎች ላይ የተጣለውን የቪዛ እገዳ በመተቸት፣ ዋሽንግተን ለፍትህ ቅድሚያ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ለፖለቲካዊ ፍጆታ ትኩረት ሰጥታለች ሲል ይከራከራል። ደራሲው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀልን ተጠያቂነት ችላ ብሎ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስሌት መሄድ በኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር እንቅፋት እንደሚሆን ያብራራሉ። ለደረሰው ግፍ ተጠያቂነትን ባለማረጋገጥ የሚወሰዱ እርምጃዎች የአለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት መርሆዎችን የሚጻረሩ እንደሆኑ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Barruun kun dhorkaa viizaa mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganoota TPLF irratti fudhate kan komatu yoo ta'u, Washington haqaa fi dhugaa irratti qabxii siyaasaa akka caalchifatte ibsa. Barreessaan kun, dhumaatii sabaa fi waldhabdee darbeef itti gaafatamummaa osoo hin mirkaneessin, mala siyaasaa qofa hordofuun nagaa waaraa Itoophiyaa keessatti fiduu akka hin dandeenye akeekkachiisa. Tarkaanfiin kun haqa dhabeessa ta'uun isaa fi qajeelfamoota mirga namoomaa addunyaa irra darbuu isaa ibsa.

title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
english: Israeli authorities are seizing approximately 450 acres of land from Palestinians in the occupied West Bank to develop the ancient site of Sebastia into a national park. Local landowners and residents fear this move will permanently alienate them from their ancestral property and cultural heritage. UNESCO has officially designated the area as a World Heritage site in danger, citing concerns that the project could threaten the integrity of the historical location and displace the local community.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በዌስት ባንክ የሚገኘውን ጥንታዊ የሰባስቲያ ቦታ ወደ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ ለመቀየር ከፍልስጤማውያን 450 ኤከር የሚጠጋ መሬት እየነጠቁ ይገኛሉ። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ይህ ድርጊት ከቀዬአቸውና ከባህላዊ ቅርሶቻቸው እንደሚያፈናቅላቸው ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የትምህርት፣ የሳይንስ እና የባህል ድርጅት (UNESCO) ይህንን አካባቢ በአደጋ ላይ ያለ የዓለም ቅርስ መሆኑን ያወጀ ሲሆን፣ ፕሮጀክቱ የታሪካዊ ቦታውን ይዘት ሊጎዳ እና ነዋሪዎችን ሊያፈናቅል እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el iddoo durii kan Sebaastiyaa jedhamu kan Zoonii Giddu-galeessa (West Bank) keessatti argamu gara paarkii biyyaatti jijjiiruuf jecha lafa Paalastayinoonni abbaa itti ta'an heektaara 450 ol ta'u fudhachaa jira. Namoonni naannichaa lafti kun kan isaanii fi kan akaakayyuu isaanii ta'uu isaa ibsuun, tarkaanfiin kun qabeenyaa fi seenaa isaanii irraa isaan gargar baasa jedhanii yaadda'u. Dhaabbanni UNESCO iddoo kana akka lafa seena-qabeessa diigamaa jiruufi bakka xiyyeeffannoo barbaaduutti ramadee jira; hojiin kunis seenaa iddoo sanaa balleessuu fi uummata naannichaa buqqisuu akka danda'u hubachiisee jira.

title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?
english: France has experienced its worst wildfire season since World War Two, destroying over 300,000 acres of land. While climate change is a major underlying factor, authorities have arrested 420 people for allegedly starting fires, either intentionally or through negligence. Critics, however, argue that these mass arrests may be excessive, questioning whether the government is using these prosecutions to deflect from its own lack of disaster preparedness.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ እጅግ የከፋውን የጫካ እሳት አደጋ አስተናግዳ ከ300,000 ሄክታር በላይ መሬት ወድሟል። የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ለችግሩ ዋነኛ ምክንያት ቢሆንም፣ መንግስት ሆን ብለው ወይም በቸልተኝነት እሳት ለኮሱ የተጠረጠሩ 420 ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ይሁን እንጂ ብዙዎች ይህ የጅምላ እስር ከመጠን ያለፈ እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ መንግስት የራሱን ዝግጅት ማነስ ለመሸፈን እየሞከረ ነው ብለው ይተቻሉ።
oromo: Faransaay keessatti gubaan bosonaa waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda mudatee hin beekne kan mudate yoo ta'u, lafti hektaara 300,000 ol ta'u barbadoofera. Jijjiiramni qilleensaa sababa guddaa ta'us, mootummaan namoota 420 ta'an gubaa kana ofiif ykn waan ofeeggannoo hin qabneef qabdee jirti. Haa ta'u malee, qaoleen tokko tokko qabxiin kun baay'ee cimaa fi sirrii kan hin taane dha jechuun, mootummaan rakkoo qophii dhabuu isaa dhoksuuf kan godhuu dha jechuun ni mormu.

title: Perez Hilton faces long recovery after self-harm livestream
english: American celebrity blogger Perez Hilton is currently in stable but serious condition in a Florida hospital following a mental health crisis. Authorities were alerted by viewers after he livestreamed an act of self-harm, leading to his hospitalization under the state's mental health laws. His family has confirmed that he requires a lengthy recovery period and upcoming surgery following significant blood loss.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ታዋቂ የብሎግ ባለቤት ፔሬዝ ሂልተን የአእምሮ ጤና ቀውስ ካጋጠመው በኋላ በፍሎሪዳ በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል ውስጥ ህክምና እየተደረገለት ይገኛል። ግለሰቡ በቲክቶክ ቀጥታ ስርጭት ላይ እያለ እራሱን እንደጎዳ በሰዎች ጥቆማ መሰረት በፖሊስ ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስዷል። የቤተሰቦቹ መግለጫ እንዳመለከተው፣ ብዙ ደም በመፍሰሱ ምክንያት በቀጣይ ቀናት የቀዶ ጥገና የሚደረግለት ሲሆን፣ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማገገም ረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚወስድበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Blogger-iin beekamaan Ameerikaa Perez Hilton rakkoo fayyaa sammuu mudatee erga hospitaala galee booda, amma haalli isaa tasgabbaa’aa ta’us hamaa dha. Namichi kun erga livestream-ii TikTok irratti of miidhee booda, namoota isa ilaalaa turaniin erga gabaafamee booda poolisiin gara hospitaalaatti isa geessaniiru. Maatiin isaa akka ibsanitti, dhiiga baay'ee waan dhabeef guyyoota dhufan keessa baqaqsanii hodhuu kan godhamuuf yoo ta'u, fayyuun isaas yeroo dheeraa kan fudhatu ta'a.

title: Car bomb hits Colombia highway day after new president sworn in
english: A car bomb explosion severely damaged a toll booth located on a major Colombian highway. The incident occurred on Saturday, just one day after the country's new president officially began his term. Military officials have attributed the attack to splinter groups associated with the former FARC rebel organization.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ዋና መንገድ ላይ የተጠመደ የመኪና ቦምብ የክፍያ ጣቢያን አውድሟል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው የአገሪቱ አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት ስልጣን ከተረከቡ ማግስት ነው። የጦር ኃይሉ ለዚህ ድርጊት ተጠያቂ ያደረገው የቀድሞው የፋርክ (FARC) አማፂ ቡድን ክፍሎችን ነው።
oromo: Konkolaataan boombii hidhattee ture daandii guddaa Kolombiyaa irratti bakka gatii kaffaltii miidhee jira. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame guyyaa tokko booda pirezidaantiin biyyattii haaraan aangoo erga qabatanii booda. Humnoonni waraanaa haleellaa kanaaf kan itti gaafatamummaa fudhatan garee rebela duraanii FARC kan ta'anidha.

title: Iran seeks way out of ‘neither war nor peace’ stalemate with US
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is looking to resolve the ongoing diplomatic standoff with the United States by utilizing mediation through Oman. Iran has established specific conditions for improving relations and reopening the critical Strait of Hormuz, which include the removal of American economic sanctions and payment for past war-related damages. This initiative aims to shift the current uneasy state of tension toward a more stable relationship.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት መስኡድ 페ዘሽኪያን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያለውን ውጥረት የተሞላበት ግንኙነት በኦማን በኩል በሚደረግ ድርድር ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ኢራን ግንኙነታቸውን ለማሻሻል እና የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን ለመክፈት አሜሪካ ማዕቀቦችን እንድታነሳና ለጦርነት ጉዳት ካሳ እንድትከፍል ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጣለች። ይህ ጥረት አሁን ያለውን የጥርጣሬ ሁኔታ ወደተሻለ መረጋጋት ለመቀየር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa waliin qaban furuuf karaa Omaan marii gaggeessaa jiru. Iraan hariiroo isaanii fooyyessuufi daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan sanciiwwan akka kaastuu fi miidhaa waraanaatiif kaffaltii akka raawwattu gaafatteetti. Karoorri kun haala amma jiru irraa gara nagaa fi tasgabbii qabutti ce’uuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Ghana’s cashew apples get a second life
english: Ghanaian cashew farmers are starting to turn cashew apples, which were previously discarded as waste, into new sources of income. Researchers are developing techniques to process this perishable fruit into various food products like juice and sausages while overcoming challenges like its short shelf life and bitter taste. This initiative aims to help rural communities maximize their harvest gains and create more economic opportunities through better processing infrastructure.
amharic: የጋና የለውዝ አምራች ገበሬዎች ከዚህ ቀደም ይጣሉ የነበሩትን የለውዝ ፍሬ (ካሼው አፕል) ወደ ገቢ ምንጭነት እየቀየሩ ይገኛሉ። ተመራማሪዎች ይህን በፍጥነት የሚበላሽ ፍሬ እንደ ጭማቂ እና ቋሊማ ባሉ የምግብ ምርቶች ለመቀየር እና የጣዕም ችግሮቹን ለመፍታት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ገበሬዎች ከምርታቸው ተጨማሪ ገቢ እንዲያገኙ እና የገጠር ማህበረሰቦችን ኢኮኖሚ ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Qonnaan bultoonni Ganaa kan kanaan dura akka qophiitti gatamaa ture kan 'cashew apple' jedhamu jijjiiranii gara madda galii haaraatti geeddaruuf hojjechaa jiru. Qorattoonni kuduraa dafee badu kana gara dhangala'aa fi soorata garaagaraatti jijjiiruun akkasumas dhadhabbii isaa hir'isuuf mala adda addaa uumaa jiru. Sagantaan kun qonnaan bultoonni bu'aa midhaan isaanii irraa argatan dabaluu fi misooma gandaa cimsuuf gargaara.

title: Hamas says ready to go ahead with Gaza plan
english: Hamas has confirmed its commitment to a US-supported peace proposal that includes disarming its forces and handing control to a new Palestinian governing body. While the group is pushing for international pressure on Israel to move forward, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has distanced himself from the agreement. The situation remains uncertain as Israel denies accepting the specific terms of the current draft.
amharic: ሀማስ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን የጋዛ የሰላም እቅድ ለመተግበር ዝግጁ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ እቅድ ታጣቂ ቡድኑ ትጥቁን ፈትቶ ስልጣኑን ለአዲስ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር አካል እንዲያስረክብ የሚጠይቅ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መንግስታቸው በዚህ ረቂቅ ስምምነት ላይ አለመስማማቱን በመግለጽ እቅዱን ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Hamaas karoora nagaa Gaazaatiif Ameerikaan deggerame hojii irra oolchuuf qophiidha jedheera. Karoorri kun humnoota hidhattootaa fi eenyummaa isaanii mootummaa Falasxiin haaraa hundaa'uuf akka dabarsanii kennan gaafata. Haa ta'u malee, muummeen ministiraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuun mootummaan isaanii waliigaltee kana akka hin fudhanne ibsuun shakkii uumeera.

title: Pakistani defence minister calls for 'united military front' against Israel
english: Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has urged Muslim nations to form a collective military alliance to counter Israel. He characterized the Israeli state as a threat to the Islamic world that seeks to divide Muslim countries. Asif emphasized that this united front is necessary to ensure the Palestinian cause is resolved according to their desires.
amharic: የፓኪስታን መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ካዋጃ አሲፍ የእስልምና ሀገራት በእስራኤል ላይ በጋራ ወታደራዊ ግንባር እንዲሰለፉ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። እስራኤል የእስልምናውን ዓለም ለስጋት የዳረገች እና ሙስሊም ሀገራትን እርስ በርስ ለማጋጨት የምትሞክር ሀገር መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። እንደ ሚኒስትሩ አባባል፣ የፍልስጤም ህዝብ ጥያቄ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ሙስሊም ሀገራት አንድ ላይ መቆም አለባቸው።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Paakistaan Khawaja Asif, biyyoonni Musliimaa Israa'el irratti duula waraanaa tokkummaan akka gaggeessan waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Israa'el addunyaa Musliimaaf soda akka taateefi biyyoota Musliimaa wal-lolchiisuuf kan yaaltu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ministirichi akka jedhanitti, gaaffiin ummata Filisxeem hamma furamuutti biyyoonni Musliimaa tokko ta'uun dirqama ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia, Yemen condemn attack on UAE oil tanker
english: Saudi Arabia and Yemen have joined several other nations in condemning an attack on a UAE-operated oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE blames Iran for the incident, describing it as a dangerous threat to international shipping and global energy supplies. The Saudi government has demanded that Iran put an immediate end to its aggressive actions in the region.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና የመን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት አውግዘዋል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች ለጥቃቱ ኢራንን ተጠያቂ ያደረገች ሲሆን፣ ድርጊቱ በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እና በባህር ትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ላይ አደጋ እንደደቀነ አስታውቃለች። ሳውዲ አረቢያ በበኩሏ ኢራን በቀጠናው የምታደርገውን ጥቃት በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም ጠይቃለች።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa fi Yaman miidhaa markaba boba'aa kan UAE irratti galaana Hormuz keessatti raawwatame balaaleffataniiru. UAE haleellaa kanaaf Iran kan himatte yoo ta'u, gochi kun nageenya galaanaarratti fi dhiyeessii boba'aa addunyaarratti balaa cimaa akka qabu ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Saudii Arabiyaas, Iran gocha hammeenyaa qabdu kana daftee akka dhaabdu gaafateera.

title: Fire doused at Saudi Aramco facility in Jizan, Saudi ministry says
english: Emergency crews successfully put out a fire that started early in the morning at a Saudi Aramco refinery located in Jizan. Officials confirmed that there were no injuries resulting from the incident. The specific reason behind the blaze remains unknown, though the site has previously been a target for Houthi militants.
amharic: በጂዛን በሚገኘው የሳዑዲ አራምኮ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያ ማለዳ ላይ ተቀስቅሶ የነበረው የእሳት አደጋ በአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች መቆጣጠር ተችሏል። በደረሰው አደጋ ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ የሀገሪቱ የኢነርጂ ሚኒስቴር አረጋግጧል። የእሳቱ መነሻ ምክንያት እስካሁን ባይታወቅም፣ ቀደም ሲል ጣቢያው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ኢላማ ሆኖ እንደነበር ይታወቃል።
oromo: Buufata qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa kan Saudi Aramco, magaala Jizanitti argamu irratti ganama kanaan ibiddi ka'ee ture dhaamsiiftuun to'atameera. Ministeerri anniisaa biyyattii akka ibsetti, balaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuu tokko illee hin geenye. Sababni ibiddi kun itti ka'e hanga ammaatti kan hin beekamne yoo ta'u, bakki kun kanaan dura xiyyeeffannoo garee Houtii ta'ee akka ture ni yaadatama.

title: Israeli troops enter Lebanese village, erect earthen barrier overnight
english: Israeli forces entered Zawtar al-Gharbiya, a Lebanese village intended to be under the Lebanese army's control, and constructed a dirt barrier blocking its eastern access road. Although local officials reported the midnight movement, the Israeli military claimed they had no information regarding the incident. This development occurs amid ongoing military conflict in southern Lebanon that has caused significant casualties and displacement.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በሊባኖስ ጦር ቁጥጥር ስር መሆን በሚገባው የዛውታር አል-ጋርቢያ መንደር ውስጥ በመግባት የመንገድ መግቢያውን የሚዘጋ የአፈር ግድብ ሰርተዋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህንን እንቅስቃሴ ቢያሳውቁም የእስራኤል ጦር ግን ስለ ክስተቱ የሚያውቀው ነገር እንደሌለ ገልጿል። ይህ ድርጊት በሊባኖስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት እና መፈናቀልን ባስከተለው አጠቃላይ ግጭት መካከል የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el ganda Liibaanoos kan Zawtar al-Gharbiya jedhamu, kan humnoonni Liibaanoos to’achuu qaban, keessa seenuun daandii gara bahaatti geessu cufuuf qarqara biyyeetti fayyadamanii daangaa ijaaraniru. Hogganoonni naannichaa sochiin kun halkan keessa akka raawwatame ibsanis, waraanni Israa'el garuu waa'ee mudannoo kanaa ragaa akka hin qabne dubbateera. Gochi kun walitti bu’iinsa kibba Liibaanoositti gaggeeffamaa jiruufi miidhaa namoota hedduu qaqqabsiise keessatti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Helicopter crash kills pilot and crew member amid Utah wildfire battle
english: A firefighting helicopter crashed near Richfield, Utah, while battling the extensive Widemouth 2 wildfire, resulting in the deaths of the pilot and one crew member. Due to dangerous fire conditions and difficult terrain, rescue teams were delayed in reaching the wreckage to recover the victims. Despite this tragedy, officials confirmed that firefighting operations will continue, with the blaze currently 24 percent contained after burning over 111,000 acres.
amharic: በዩታ ግዛት ሪችፊልድ አቅራቢያ የሚገኘውን ትልቅ የእሳት አደጋ ለመቆጣጠር ሲሞክር የነበረ ሄሊኮፕተር ተከስክሶ የፓይለቱ እና የአንድ ሰራተኛ ህይወት አልፏል። በአካባቢው የነበረው ከፍተኛ እሳትና አስቸጋሪው መልክዓ ምድር የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ቦታው ላይ ደርሰው አስክሬኑን ለማውጣት መቸገራቸውን ተከትሎ የቆየ ቢሆንም፣ በመጨረሻም የሟቾች አስክሬን ተገኝቷል። በደረሰው አሳዛኝ አደጋ ምክንያት ስራው ባይቆምም፣ እስካሁን ከ111,000 ኤከር በላይ ያቃጠለው እሳቱ በ24 በመቶ ብቻ መቆጣጠር ተችሏል።
oromo: Naannoo Richfield, Utah keessatti, ibidda bosonaa guddaa dhaamsuuf heelikopterri deeggarsa gochaa ture erga kufuun qajeechisaa fi hojjetaan tokko lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Sababa ibidda cimaa fi lafa itti kufuun rakkisaa ta'eef, gareen furmaata hatattamaa foon isaanii baasuuf yeroo fudhataniiru. Rakkoo kana hunda keessattuu hojiin ibidda dhaamsuu itti fufee kan jiru yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti lafa hektaara 45,000 ol gubate keessaa dhibbeentaa 24 qofa to'achuun danda'ameera.

title: National Bank Forces Anbesa Bank Board Re-run, All Incumbents Out
english: Anbesa Bank has appointed a completely new Board of Directors following an intervention by the National Bank of Ethiopia. The central bank invalidated the previous election held nine months ago and mandated a supervised re-run. Shareholders conducted the new vote peacefully at the Adwa Victory Memorial Museum to ensure regulatory compliance.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ ከዘጠኝ ወራት በፊት የተካሄደውን የአንበሳ ባንክ የዳይሬክተሮች ቦርድ ምርጫ ውድቅ በማድረግ ድጋሚ ምርጫ እንዲደረግ አዟል። በዚህም መሰረት ባንኩ በአዲስ አበባ አድዋ ድል መታሰቢያ ሙዚየም በተካሄደ ልዩ ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ሙሉ ለሙሉ አዲስ የቦርድ አባላትን መርጧል። የምርጫ ሂደቱ በቁጥጥር ስር ሆኖ በሰላማዊ መንገድ መጠናቀቁ ታውቋል።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa filannoo boordii daayrektoota Baankii Anbasaa kan kanaan dura geggeeffame fudhatama dhabsiisee akka irra deebi'u ajajeera. Baankichi qajeelfama kana hordofuun, bakka yaadannoo injifannoo Aduwaatti walga'ii addaa geggeessuun miseensota boordii haaraa guutummaatti filateera. Filannoon kun hordoffii qajeelfamaa waliin nagaadhaan xumurameera.

title: The Storm Passed, the Freight Bill Did Not
english: A Bishoftu flower farm has successfully rebuilt its facilities after being destroyed by a severe storm last year. Despite this recovery, the business and many other Ethiopian exporters are now struggling with a massive increase in shipping and freight costs. This financial burden is straining the broader economy as businesses across various sectors face challenges with international trade routes.
amharic: በቢሾፍቱ የሚገኝ የአበባ እርሻ ባለፈው ዓመት በደረሰ ከፍተኛ አውሎ ንፋስ የፈረሱ መሰረተ ልማቶቹን መልሶ መገንባት ችሏል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የጭነት እና የመጓጓዣ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ እርሻው እና ሌሎች ኢትዮጵያውያን ላኪዎች ከፍተኛ ፈተና ውስጥ ገብተዋል። ይህ የመጓጓዣ ዋጋ መናር በተለያዩ የንግድ ዘርፎች ላይ ጫና በመፍጠር በአገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qonnaan bultoonni abaabuu Bishooftuu keessa jiran, erga obomboleettiin waggaa darbe miidhaa irraan ga’ee booda, gamoowwan isaanii deebisanii ijaarrataniiru. Ta’us, gatiin fe'umsaa fi geejjibaa dabaluun isaanii, qonnaan bultootaa fi ergitoota oomisha biroo kan biyyattiin miidhaa guddaa irra buuseera. Rakkoon gatii geejjibaa kun daldaltoota sadarkaa gara garaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, dinagdee biyyattii irratti gufuu ta'eera.

title: The Hotel That Housed the OAU Meets the Wrecking Ball
english: The historic Ethiopia Hotel, a notable landmark located on Yohannes Street, is currently being demolished. Crews have started tearing down the conference hall, and the main building is expected to be fully removed by October 2026. Several nearby small shops have already vacated the area to make way for the upcoming site clearance.
amharic: በዮሐንስ ጎዳና ላይ የሚገኘው ታሪካዊው የኢትዮጵያ ሆቴል በአሁኑ ወቅት እየፈረሰ ይገኛል። የሆቴሉ የኮንፈረንስ አዳራሽ መፍረስ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ዋናው ህንጻም በጥቅምት ወር 2019 ዓ.ም ይጠናቀቃል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል። በስፍራው የነበሩ ትናንሽ ሱቆችም ለግንባታው ስራ ሲባል ንብረታቸውን አንስተው ለቀዋል።
oromo: Hoteelli Itoophiyaa kan daandii Yohannis irratti argamu fi seenaa qabu diigamaa jira. Hojjettoonni galma walga'ii diiguu jalqabanii jiru; ijaarsi guddaanis hanga ji'a Onkololeessa bara 2026 tti guutumaatti diigamee xumurama jedhamee eegama. Suuqonni xixiqqoo naannichatti argamanis bakka sana qulqulleessuuf jecha gadi lakkisanii bahaniru.

title: Tax on Alcohol, Tobacco Worked. Study Finds That May Be the Problem
english: A recent study indicates that excise tax reforms on alcohol and tobacco products have successfully met their goals of increasing prices and reducing consumption. However, the report highlights that this success creates new economic challenges for the government. Officials are now facing a dilemma as the decline in sales is negatively impacting expected tax revenue.
amharic: በአልኮል እና በሲጋራ ምርቶች ላይ የተጣለው የኤክሳይስ ታክስ ማሻሻያ ዋጋን በመጨመርና ፍጆታን በመቀነስ ረገድ ውጤታማ ሆኗል። ይሁን እንጂ፣ ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው ይህ ስኬት በመንግስት ገቢ ላይ ያልተጠበቀ ተግዳሮት ፈጥሯል። የሸቀጦች ፍላጎት መቀነስ በታክስ መሰብሰብ ሂደት ላይ ጫና እየፈጠረ መምጣቱ ለባለሥልጣናት አዲስ ፈተና ሆኗል።
oromo: Fooyya'iinsi gibira alkooholaa fi tamboo irratti godhame gatii dabaluu fi fayyadama hir'isuun bu'aa argamsiiseera. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoon tokko akka ibsutti, bu'aan kun mootummaaf rakkoo dinagdee haaraa uumeera. Fayyadamni oomishaalee kanaa gadi bu'uun isaa galii gibiraa irraa argamu irratti dhiibbaa waan geessiseef, qaamoleen mootummaa dhimma kana irratti gadi fageenyaan yaadaa jiru.

title: Bus Firms Spend Hundreds of Millions, Hit Bank, Tariff, Charging Walls
english: Three inter-city transport companies have invested 450 million Birr in new buses to comply with updated government fleet requirements. However, these firms are now struggling to manage these massive expenses due to difficult bank financing, high tariffs, and insufficient charging infrastructure. The companies are currently working to replace 1,600 vehicles to meet these strict new transport directives.
amharic: ሶስት የሀገር አቋራጭ የትራንስፖርት ድርጅቶች በመንግስት የተጣለውን አዲስ የተሽከርካሪዎች መመዘኛ ለማሟላት 450 ሚሊዮን ብር ወጪ አድርገዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ድርጅቶቹ በባንክ ብድር አሰጣጥ፣ በከፍተኛ ታሪፍ እና በኃይል መሙያ ጣቢያዎች እጥረት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ጫና ውስጥ መግባታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ኩባንያዎቹ በመንግስት በተደነገገው አዲስ መመሪያ መሰረት 1,600 አሮጌ ተሽከርካሪዎችን ለመተካት ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dhaabbileen geejjiba biyya-addaa sadii fedhii mootummaan dhiyeesse guutuuf jecha baska 450 miliyoonaa baasanii konkolaattota haaraa bitaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, dhaabbileen kunniin rakkoo liqii baankii, gibira ol-aanaa fi hanqina bu'uuraalee misoomaa teeknooloojii charge gochuu irraa kan ka'e rakkoo maallaqaa hamaa keessa jiru. Dhaabbileen kunniin qajeelfama haaraa mootummaan baaseen konkolaattota 1,600 bakka buusuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Israeli settler attacks rise as West Bank residents lose land
english: Violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank is intensifying, leading to significant land loss for local residents. Reports indicate that the current right-wing Israeli government is encouraging this behavior to maintain the support of settler voters ahead of upcoming elections. This ongoing conflict has created a hostile environment for Palestinians living in areas near Bethlehem and across the region.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች የሚደርስባቸው የጥቃት እና የመሬት መነጠቅ ችግር እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ዘገባዎች ያመለክታሉ። አሁን ያለው የቀኝ ዘመም የእስራኤል መንግስት በመጪው ምርጫ የሰፋሪዎችን ድምጽ ለማግኘት ሲል ለዚህ ድርጊት መበረታቻ እየሰጠ እንደሚገኝ ተነግሯል። ይህ ሁኔታ በቤተልሔም አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችን ህይወት አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Naannoo baankii dhihaa keessatti haleellaa fi buqqaatiin lafaa irra jiraattoota Falasxiin irra gahu qonnaan bultoota Israa'el irraa maddun dabalaa jira. Mootummaan Israa'el kan yeroo ammaa qabee jiru, filannoo dhufu irratti sagalee jiraattoota kanaa argachuuf jecha gocha kana jajjabeessaa akka jiru himameera. Haalli kun jireenya jiraattoota magaalaa Beetelhemii fi naannoo ishee keessatti balaa fi miidhaa guddaa uumaa jira.

title: Hungary nominates former Supreme Court chief Andras Baka for presidency
english: The Tisza party in Hungary has nominated former Supreme Court Chief Andras Baka as their presidential candidate to replace the previous leader. Baka is well-known for his commitment to judicial independence and was previously dismissed by the Orban administration for his criticism of government reforms. His nomination is viewed as a symbolic effort to restore the rule of law after the party's recent election victory.
amharic: የሃንጋሪው ቲዛ ፓርቲ የቀድሞ የጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ዋና ዳኛ የነበሩትን አንድራስ ባካን ለፕሬዝዳንትነት እጩ አድርጎ አቅርቧል። ባካ ለፍትህ ስርዓት ነፃነት በመቆም የሚታወቁ ሲሆን ከዚህ ቀደም በመንግስት ማሻሻያዎች ላይ በመተቸታቸው ከስልጣን ተነስተው ነበር። ይህ ሹመት ፓርቲው በምርጫ ካሸነፈ በኋላ የህግ የበላይነትን ለማስፈን እየወሰደ ካለው እርምጃ አንዱ ተደርጎ ታይቷል።
oromo: Paartiin Tisza kan biyya Hangarii, dura ta'aa mana murtii olaanaa kan duraanii Andras Bakaa, bakka bu'aa pirezidantii ta'anii akka filatamaniif kaadhimataniiru. Bakaa qajeeltoo walaba ta'uu mana murtii kabachiisuudhaan kan beekaman yoo ta'u, kanaan dura mootummaa Orbaan irratti qeeqaa dhiyeessuusaaniitiin aangoo irraa kaafamanii turan. Filannoon kun mootummaan haaraan kun sirna biyyattii keessatti kabaja seeraa deebisanii dhaabuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiran keessaa tokko dha.

title: Iran war live: Tehran demands end to US blockade to reopen Strait of Hormuz
english: Iran's Revolutionary Guard has set specific conditions to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, demanding that the United States lift its naval blockade and provide compensation for war-related damages. While Washington is pressing for guarantees to stop attacks on commercial vessels, officials suggest that Iranian leadership has indicated no intention to permanently close the strategic waterway. The situation remains a critical focal point of the ongoing tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እንደገና ለመክፈት አሜሪካ የጣለችውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ እንድታነሳ እና የጦርነት ካሳ እንድትከፍል ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን አስቀምጧል። ዋሽንግተን በመርከቦች ላይ የሚሰነዘረውን ጥቃት ለማስቆም ቁርጠኝነት እየፈለገች ቢሆንም፣ የኢራን አመራር የባህር መንገዱን ሙሉ ለሙሉ የመዝጋት እቅድ እንደሌላቸው መግለጻቸውን የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ተናግረዋል። ይህ ጉዳይ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ባለው የውጥረት ሁኔታ ውስጥ ወሳኝ ነጥብ ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humnoonni Irree Eegumsa Islaamaa kan Iraan, daandii galaana Hormuz banuuf, Ameerikaan blokii galaana irra keesse akka kaastu fi miidhaa waraanaatiif kaffaltii akka raawwattu gaafataniiru. Mootummaan Waashingitan haleellaa markaboota irratti raawwatamu dhaabsisuuf yaalii gochaa jiruus, hoggantoonni Iraan daandii kana guututti cufuuf karoora akka hin qabne ibsuun isaanii gabaafameera. Hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufuun isaa, daandii galaana kanaa irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira.

title: Turkiye says Mecca defence pact not aimed at Iran
english: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have signed a new trilateral defense pact in Mecca that features a mutual defense clause similar to NATO’s. Turkish officials clarified that the agreement is not aimed at Iran, noting that it does not name any specific country as a threat. The deal focuses on military cooperation, including joint training, intelligence sharing, and the exchange of defense technology.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ ከተማ አዲስ የሶስትዮሽ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ስምምነቱ እንደ ኔቶ የጋራ መከላከያ አንቀጽ፣ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል። የቱርክ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱ ኢራንን ያነጣጠረ እንዳልሆነ እና ምንም አይነት ሀገርን እንደ ስጋት ያልለየ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Turkiin, Saudii Arabiyaafi Paakistaan magaalaa Makkaatti waliigaltee ittisa biyyaalessaa kan sadan gidduutti ta'e tokko mallatteessaniiru. Waliigalteen kun akkuma ka'umsa NATO, biyyoota sadan kana keessaa tokko irratti yoo haleellaan raawwatame, kanneen biroo irratti akka raawwatametti kan ilaalamu ta'a. Abbootiin taayitaa Turkiin akka ibsanitti, waliigalteen kun biyya Iran kan hin ilaallanneefi biyya tokko iyyuu akka diinaatti kan hin ramadne ta'uu beekaniiru.

title: Vance says talks 'make progress' but Iran must make long-term changes
english: US Vice President JD Vance announced that recent discussions with Iran have shown some positive momentum. However, he emphasized that the US is still waiting to see if Tehran will commit to the lasting structural changes needed to improve diplomatic relations. Vance noted that if these long-term commitments are not met, the US will continue its policy of pressure while focusing on securing energy interests for American citizens.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር የተካሄዱ የቅርብ ጊዜ ውይይቶች መሻሻል እያሳዩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም አሜሪካ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን ለማሻሻል የሚያስችል ዘላቂ ለውጥ በኢራን በኩል እንደሚኖር እየተጠባበቀች መሆኗን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ መሰረታዊ ለውጦች ካልመጡ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን ጫና በመቀጠል፣ ለራሷ የኢነርጂ ፍላጎት ቅድሚያ እንደምትሰጥ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaa pirezidantii Amerikaa JD Vance mariin dhihoo kana Iran waliin taasifame guddina tokko agarsiisus, walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf Iran jijjiirama yeroo dheeraa gochuun ishee ammayyuu gaaffii keessa akka jiru ibsaniiru. Vance akka jedhanitti, Iran yoo jijjiirama barbaadamu kanneen hin taasisne ta'e, Amerikaan dhiibbaa ishee itti fuftee akkasumas fedhii ishee kan anniisaa irratti xiyyeeffachuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Fleet of 56 tankers shipping oil through Hormuz 'covertly', tracking firm says
english: A tracking firm reported that 56 oil tankers are currently moving through the Strait of Hormuz while hiding their locations. These ships are performing secret fuel transfers in the Gulf of Oman to facilitate oil exports from nations near Iran. This method allows the vessels to operate without digital detection while maintaining the regional oil supply.
amharic: አንድ መርከቦችን የሚከታተል ድርጅት 56 የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦች ቦታቸውን በመደበቅ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ በኩል እያለፉ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። እነዚህ መርከቦች ከአረብ ሀገራት የሚመጣውን ነዳጅ በኦማን ባህር ውስጥ በድብቅ እያዘዋወሩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ አካሄድ መርከቦቹ የዲጂታል መከታተያ ሳይጠቀሙ የነዳጅ ንግድን እንዲያቀላጥፉ ያስችላቸዋል።
oromo: dhaabbanni markaboota hordofu tokko, markaboonni boba'aa 56 ta'an bakka isaanii dhoksanii gara baha Hormuz keessa darbaa akka jiran ibseera. Markaboonni kunneen biyyoota Arabaa irraa boba'aa fudhatanii, galaana Omaan keessatti karaa dhokataa ta'een wal jijjiirraa taasisu. Adeemsi kun markaboonni kunneen meeshaa dijitaalaan osoo hin beekamin hojii daldala boba'aa akka gaggeessan isaan gargaara.

title: Girl and her father wounded as Israeli drone crashes in southern Lebanon
english: A young girl and her father sustained injuries after an Israeli drone fell near their home in Kfar Rumman, southern Lebanon. Reports indicate the aircraft experienced a mechanical failure while flying over the region before landing abruptly. Local authorities confirmed the incident took place near the family's property.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው ከፋር ሩማን ከተማ አንድ የእስራኤል ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) በመከስከሱ አንድ ወጣት ልጅ እና አባቷ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ድሮኑ በክልሉ ላይ እየበረረ ሳለ የቴክኒክ ችግር በማጋጠሙ የተነሳ ነው ከቤታቸው አጠገብ የወደቀው። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት አደጋው በቤተሰቡ መኖሪያ አካባቢ መከሰቱን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Kibba Libaanoos, magaalaa Kaafar Ruumaanitti xiyyaaronni nama hin qabne kan Israa'el tokko kufuu isaatiin mucayyoon tokko fi abbaan ishee miidhamaniiru. Xiyyaarichi naannichatti barrisaa osoo jiruu rakkoo teeknikaa mudatee erga kufee booda manuma isaanii biratti kan kuse ta'u gabaasameera. Qaamoleen naannichaa balaan kun mana maatii sanaa biratti gahuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Israel issues tender for 627 housing units in West Bank settlement
english: Israeli authorities have announced a plan to build 627 new housing units within the Kochav Yaakov settlement located in the West Bank. Construction companies have until the end of November 2026 to submit their bids for this project, which advanced from the planning stage to the bidding process very quickly. This development is part of a broader trend, as officials have released numerous tenders for residential and commercial expansion across various settlements throughout the year.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚገኘው ኮቻቭ ያኮቭ ሰፈር ውስጥ 627 አዳዲስ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ጨረታ አውጥተዋል። የግንባታ ኩባንያዎች ለዚህ ፕሮጀክት የመወዳደሪያ ሃሳባቸውን እስከ ህዳር 2026 መጨረሻ ድረስ ማስገባት ይጠበቅባቸዋል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ከዕቅድ ምዕራፍ ወደ ጨረታ በፍጥነት የተሸጋገረ ሲሆን፣ በዘንድሮው ዓመት በተለያዩ ሰፈሮች ውስጥ የቤት ግንባታዎችን እና የንግድ ማዕከላትን ለማስፋፋት በርካታ ጨረታዎች መውጣታቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qarxii dhiyaa keessatti bakka Kochav Yaakov jedhamutti manneen jireenyaa 627 ijaaruuf caalbaasii baaseera. Dhaabbileen ijaarsaa caalbaasii kanaaf hamma dhuma ji'a Sadaasaa bara 2026tti dorgomuun barbaachisaadha. Proojektiin kun sadarkaa karooraarraa gara caalbaasiitti ariitiin kan ce'e yoo ta'u, bara kana keessa naannoolee kana keessatti babal'ina iddoo jireenyaa fi daldalaa irratti xiyyeeffatan caalbaasiileen hedduun ba'aa turaniiru.

title: Vance says US ‘destroyed’ Iran’s nuclear programme
english: US Vice President JD Vance recently stated that the United States has successfully dismantled Iran's nuclear capabilities and weakened its military forces. Meanwhile, Iran is refusing to reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the US provides compensation and lifts its current naval blockade. These conflicting positions highlight the ongoing tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ አሜሪካ የአን ኢራንን የኑክሌር መርሃ ግብር እንዳፈራረሰች እና ወታደራዊ አቅሟን እንደገደበች ተናግረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን የአሜሪካ የባህር ላይ ማገጃ እንዲነሳ እና ካሳ እንዲከፈላት በመጠየቅ ሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥን እንደማትከፍት አስታውቃለች። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የፖለቲካ ውጥረት አሁንም መቀጠሉን ያሳያል።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Ameerikaa JD Vance akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan sagantaa niwuukilaraa Iraan mancaasuu fi humna waraana ishee dadhabsiisuu dandeesseetti. Gama biraatiin, Iraan hanga Ameerikaan kaffaltii beenyaa kaffaltuufi daangaa galaana ishee irra kaayame kaastutti, karaa galaana Hormuz banuu akka hin dandeenye beeksifteetti. Wal-dhabdeen kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan dhiphise dha.

title: Four killed in helicopter crash in Brazil’s Rio de Janeiro
english: A helicopter crashed in Brazil’s Tijuca National Park, resulting in the deaths of the pilot and three Colombian tourists. The victims, who were part of a family celebrating a birthday, were on a sightseeing tour when the aircraft went down in a mountainous forest area. Following the tragedy, Rio de Janeiro officials are calling for stricter safety regulations and increased oversight of tourist helicopter flights in the city.
amharic: በብራዚል ሪዮ ደ ጄኔሮ በሚገኘው ቲጁካ ብሔራዊ ፓርክ በደረሰ የሄሊኮፕተር አደጋ የፓይለቱና የሶስት ኮሎምቢያዊ ቱሪስቶች ህይወት አልፏል። ልደት ለማክበር የመጡት የቤተሰብ አባላት በከተማዋ በረራ ላይ እያሉ ነበር አደጋው የደረሰው። ይህን ተከትሎ የሪዮ ደ ጄኔሮ ባለስልጣናት በከተማዋ ለቱሪዝም አገልግሎት የሚውሉ ሄሊኮፕተሮች ላይ ጥብቅ የደህንነት ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Brazilii, Rio de Janeero keessatti xiyyaarri helikoptarii bosona paarikii biyyoolessaa Tijuka keessatti kufuun isaa lubbuun namoota afurii akka darbu taasiseera. Namoonni du’an kunneen qajeelchaa xiyyaarichaa fi maatii Kolombiyaa irraa dhalatan kan guyyaa dhalootaa kabajuuf dhufan turan. Balaa kana hordofee, bulchiinsi magaalattii balalii helikoptaraa irratti eegumsi nageenyaa akka cimu fi seerri haaraan akka ba'u gaafachaa jiru.

title: Crews recover 19 bodies from rubble of destroyed Gaza building
english: Civil defense workers in Gaza have recovered 19 bodies, primarily women and children, from the debris of a collapsed building in Gaza City. The search operation lasted four days but was slowed down by a severe lack of heavy machinery, forcing rescuers to rely on manual labor. Currently, an estimated 8,000 people are still missing under the ruins of buildings across the region due to ongoing conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ የሲቪል መከላከያ ሰራተኞች በፈረሰ ህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ የ19 ሰዎችን አስከሬን አውጥተዋል። አብዛኞቹ የተገኙት አስከሬኖች የሴቶች እና የህጻናት ሲሆኑ፣ የፍለጋ ስራው ከባድ ማሽነሪዎች ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት ለተከታታይ አራት ቀናት በእጅ ጥረት መከናወኑ ተገልጿል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በጋዛ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በፈረሱ ህንጻዎች ስር ከ8,000 በላይ ሰዎች የገቡበት ሳይታወቅ እንደሚገኙ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni ittisa sivilii magaala Gaza keessatti reeffa namoota 19, kanneen baay'een isaanii dubartootaa fi daa'imman ta'an, mana diigame jala baasaniiru. Hojiin barbaacha kanaa guyyaa afuriif kan ture yoo ta'u, maashinoota gurguddoo dhabuu irraa kan ka'e harka qullaa hojjetamaa ture. Ammaaf namoonni 8,000 ol ta'an magaalaa Gaza guutuu keessatti manneen diigaman jala jiru jedhamee shakkama.

title: Israeli forces shell  Gaza areas, raid several West Bank towns and villages
english: Israeli military operations have continued in Gaza with artillery and tank fire hitting multiple locations. Meanwhile, in the West Bank, Israeli forces conducted raids in several towns and used tear gas, affecting residents in the Dheisheh camp. Despite a previously established ceasefire, the ongoing violence has resulted in a significant number of Palestinian casualties, including hundreds of children.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በጋዛ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በከባድ መሳሪያ እና በታንክ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ቀጥለዋል። በሌላ በኩል በዌስት ባንክ በተደረጉ ወረራዎች እስራኤላውያን ወታደሮች እንባ ማነቂያ ጋዝ በመጠቀማቸው የዲሄሼ ካምፕ ነዋሪዎች ተጎድተዋል። ምንም እንኳን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም፣ ግጭቶቹ በመቀጠላቸው በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'eel gara Gazaatti boba'aa fi taankii fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeessuu itti fufanii jiru. Gama biraatiin, naannoo West Bank keessatti humnoonni Israa'eel magaalaalee adda addaa keessatti duula geggeessaniin, buufata Dheisheh keessatti namoonni gaazii imimmaansuu irraa miidhamaniiru. Waligalteen dhaabbii waraanaa duraan godhame ture jiraatus, haleellaa kanaan yeroo ammaa kana daa'imman hedduu dabalatee namoonni Paalestaayinii baay'een lubbuun darbaniiru.

title: Car bomb attack rattles Colombia after inauguration of hardline president
english: A car bomb exploded at a toll station in southwestern Colombia just one day after the country's new hardline president, Abelardo de la Espriella, took office. The military blames this attack on former FARC rebel factions, and while two guards were slightly injured, the government has vowed a tough response to restore national security. This incident highlights the significant challenges the new administration faces in its pledge to combat criminal groups and narco-terrorism across the nation.
amharic: አዲሱ የኮሎምቢያ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪየላ ስልጣን ከያዙ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ በሀገሪቱ ደቡብ ምዕራብ ክፍል በሚገኝ የክፍያ ጣቢያ የመኪና ቦምብ ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። የሀገሪቱ ወታደራዊ ኃይላት ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት የቀድሞው የፋርክ አማፂ ቡድን የተከፋፈሉ አባላት እንደሆኑ ገልጸዋል፤ ጥቃቱም በሁለት የጥበቃ ሰራተኞች ላይ ቀላል ጉዳት አስከትሏል። የኮሎምቢያ መንግስት ሀገሪቱን ከወንጀለኞች እና ከሽብርተኝነት ለመጠበቅ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ቃል ገብቷል።

title: 'Used as human bait': Leaked image shows elderly Palestinian men before execution by Israeli forces
english: A recently surfaced photograph reveals two elderly Palestinian men from Gaza being held blindfolded by Israeli soldiers shortly before their deaths in November 2024. Reports from journalist Younis Tirawi allege that these men were abducted from Beit Lahia and forced to act as human shields for several days by the military. The account claims the individuals were ultimately killed after being used as bait by the 92nd Battalion of the Kfir Brigade.

title: Pentagon orders arms production surge as Israeli-US war on Iran depletes missiles
english: The U.S. Department of Defense has directed weapon manufacturers to speed up production and delivery timelines due to dwindling missile stockpiles caused by the ongoing conflict between Israel and Iran. Officials emphasized that current long wait times are insufficient and have demanded detailed plans from companies to boost output within three weeks. This urgent measure highlights concerns regarding the strain placed on American military reserves.

title: Iran sets conditions for reopening Strait of Hormuz
english: A senior Iranian official has established specific demands that the United States must meet before the Strait of Hormuz can be reopened. These conditions include stopping all military threats and actions against Iran, withdrawing U.S. forces from the area, and providing financial compensation for past damages. Iran has declared that it will not compromise on these requirements during any future discussions or conflicts.

title: Will Pakistan-Saudi-Turkiye defence pact change US strategy?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have signed a significant mutual defense agreement that requires them to defend each other in the event of an attack. While the U.S. government has not yet issued a formal response, analysts are divided on whether this pact signals a shift away from American influence or a helpful step toward shared regional security. Many experts believe this deal complicates U.S. goals in the Middle East by potentially undermining the Abraham Accords and the normalization of relations between Arab nations and Israel.

title: Trump’s Former Lawyer Is Now Attorney General
english: Todd Blanche, who previously served as a lawyer for Donald Trump, has been confirmed as the new United States Attorney General. The Senate approved his appointment by a very narrow margin of 50 to 49. His confirmation has sparked significant debate due to concerns surrounding his past legal work and several ongoing controversies.

title: What are the challenges facing the Mecca agreement?
english: Saudi Arabia has entered into a new defense alliance with Turkey and Pakistan to broaden its military partnerships beyond its traditional reliance on the United States. This agreement comes amid rising regional tensions involving the Houthis in Yemen and ongoing diplomatic uncertainty regarding Iran. Experts are now debating whether this trilateral pact can serve as a functional replacement for the security protection previously guaranteed by Washington.

title: Three Palestinians killed and dozens wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza and West Bank
english: Israeli military operations and settler attacks across Gaza and the West Bank have resulted in the deaths of three Palestinians and dozens of injuries. In the West Bank, forces raided multiple cities and towns, using tear gas and live fire, while settlers assaulted residents and damaged private property. Additionally, military actions in northern Gaza led to further casualties, contributing to the rising death toll since the ongoing conflict began.

oromo: Hojiin waraanaa Israa'el fi weerarri warra biyya lafaa qabatanii jiran Gaza fi Lixaa Baankii keessatti namoota Falasxiin sadii ajjeesee, namoota hedduu ammoo mii'eessera. title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
english: Oman is mediating talks with Iran regarding the reopening of the vital Strait of Hormuz, which has been blockaded following recent regional conflicts. While officials acknowledge progress in the negotiations, Iran maintains that a full restoration of shipping traffic is conditional on the U.S. meeting specific demands. These requirements include releasing frozen assets and stopping naval blockades, leaving the timeline for any final agreement uncertain.

title: At least 200 people evacuated as wildfire rages near Lake Garda
english: A wildfire has erupted near Lake Garda in Italy, forcing the emergency evacuation of at least 200 people. The blaze began in the Tignale area, located on the lake's western shore. Authorities are working to manage the situation in this popular tourist region.

Aangoonni mootummaa naannoo tuuristoonni baay'inaan itti walgahanii kan ta'e kana keessatti ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Lebanese soldiers injured while Israeli troops intrude on southern town
english: Three Lebanese soldiers were injured while clearing unexploded explosives in the village of Zawtar al-Gharbiyah. This incident occurred shortly after reports that Israeli forces had entered the area and constructed an earthen barrier, which local officials described as a violation of a recent security agreement. While the Israeli military claims it has no knowledge of the event, the village is a key pilot zone designated for the return of displaced residents under a US-backed peace framework.

oromo: Godina Zawtar al-Gharbiyah keessatti loltoonni Libanoos sadii otoo meeshaa waraanaa hin dhoonye of irraa kaasaa jiranuu miidhaan irra gaheera. title: US slams Chinese ‘nature reserve’ as effort to claim South China Sea
english: The United States has condemned China for labeling the Scarborough Reef a 'nature reserve,' describing it as a deceptive tactic to block Filipino fishermen from their traditional waters. The U.S. stated that Beijing is using environmental excuses to reinforce its illegal territorial claims in the South China Sea. Washington reaffirmed its support for the Philippines, emphasizing the importance of maintaining an open and peaceful Indo-Pacific region.

title: ‘Debilitating’: Hunter Biden speaks out about father Joe Biden’s cancer
english: Hunter Biden recently shared that his father, former President Joe Biden, is suffering from painful, advanced prostate cancer that has spread to his bones. During a television interview, the younger Biden expressed deep sadness over his father's deteriorating health condition. Joe Biden was diagnosed with the aggressive illness in May 2025, several months after he decided to withdraw from the 2024 presidential election following concerns about his health and performance.

title: Yemen’s government forces attack Houthis amid renewed shelling of Marib
english: Yemeni government forces have launched a retaliatory offensive against Houthi positions following a series of deadly missile and drone attacks on Marib and Hadramout. This escalation, which follows the expiration of a long-standing truce, has caused significant civilian casualties and sparked fears of a return to full-scale civil war. Experts are warning that these renewed clashes indicate a dangerous shift toward broader instability in the region.

title: Turkey says Saudi-Pakistan defence pact mirrors NATO’s Article 5, Egypt could also join
english: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan have formed a new defense alliance that functions like NATO's mutual defense clause, requiring members to support each other during threats. The agreement includes a specialized secretariat based in Saudi Arabia and a ministerial committee to manage strategic decisions. Officials have clarified that this pact is not directed at Iran and noted that Egypt may be invited to join the partnership in the future.

Hojjettoonni mootummaa waligalteen kun Iraan irratti kan xiyyeeffate miti jedhaniiru; gara fuulduraatti garuu biyyi Gibxii miseensa ta'uu akka dandeessu ibsameera.

title: The influencers taking on far-right leader Nigel Farage
english: A group of social media influencers is actively challenging UK politician Nigel Farage by fact-checking his claims regarding immigration. These digital creators argue that traditional media outlets have been too lenient toward his far-right views. This movement follows Farage’s resignation as an MP, which was prompted by an investigation into his personal finances.

title: Gaza health chief urges action to ‘save’ Dr Abu Safia before it’s too late
english: Gaza’s health ministry chief is calling for immediate intervention to protect Dr. Hussam Abu Safia, who is being held by Israeli authorities. The pediatrician, who led Kamal Adwan Hospital, has reportedly suffered severe injuries due to torture and lacks essential medical attention in detention. Health officials and human rights groups are demanding his urgent release and immediate medical care, holding Israeli forces responsible for his deteriorating condition.

Ogeessi fayyaa kun hospitaala Kaamaal Adwaan hogganaanii kan turan yoo ta'u, hidhaa keessatti reebicha hamaa fi dararaa irra ga'aa jiruun miidhamuun ibsameera. title: British Columbia issues evacuation orders ahead of fast-moving wildfires
english: British Columbia has declared a state of emergency as intense, out-of-control wildfires force thousands of residents to evacuate their homes. The fires have disrupted power and water services, causing significant damage in districts like Summerland. Officials continue to manage the crisis while scientists attribute the increased frequency and severity of these blazes to climate change and extreme heat.

Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, ibidni kun akka kanaan duraa miti kan jabaateef jijjiirama qilleensaa fi ho'a qilleensaa hammeenyaa wajjin wal qabata.

title: Serbia and Ukraine pledge closer economic ties, eye free trade deal
english: Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy have met in Belgrade to strengthen economic ties and finalize a long-delayed free trade deal by the end of the year. During the visit, Serbia pledged to assist in the reconstruction of Ukrainian cities and support Ukraine's integration into the European Union. While both nations maintained their respective positions on regional sovereignty issues, they agreed to increase cooperation on infrastructure and humanitarian aid.

title: Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye pact: A new shield or strategic signal?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have signed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement, a new pact where an attack on one nation is considered an attack on all three. Although officials state the treaty is not aimed at any specific country, analysts suggest it serves as a strategic move to deter regional threats amid the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran. The agreement combines Pakistan's manpower and Saudi funding with Turkiye's advanced military industry to bolster collective regional security.

title: US Vice President confirms direct US-Iran talks over Strait of Hormuz
english: US Vice President JD Vance has announced that the Trump administration is engaging in direct negotiations with Iran to ensure consistent oil and gas shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. While maintaining economic and military pressure on Tehran, officials are observing if the country will commit to significant long-term reforms. The primary goal of these efforts is to stabilize global energy supplies and lower fuel costs for the American public.

title: France shuts mosque over Quran verses and Islamic texts used in Muslim worship
english: A French court has upheld a six-month closure order for the Chanteloup mosque near Paris, ruling that the state's restrictions on religious teachings are lawful. Authorities targeted the mosque because imams referenced Quranic verses and traditional Islamic texts during their sermons. Legal representatives for the mosque argue that this decision infringes on religious freedom and plan to appeal the ruling to the Council of State.

title: Messi's father Jorge dies aged 68 after illness
english: Jorge Messi, the father and long-term agent of football star Lionel Messi, has passed away in his home city of Rosario at age 68 following a lengthy illness. He played a crucial role in his son's legendary career, supporting him from his early days at Newell's Old Boys to his global success with Barcelona and the Argentina national team. The football community, including his former clubs, has expressed condolences to the Messi family during this difficult time.
amharic: የእግር ኳስ ኮከቡ ሊዮኔል ሜሲ አባት እና የረጅም ጊዜ ወኪል የነበሩት ሆርሄ ሜሲ በ68 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። በልጃቸው የላቀ የስፖርት ጉዞ ላይ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ የነበራቸው ሆርሄ፣ ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ እስካሁን ድረስ ባደረገው የሙያ ስኬት ጎን በመሆን ድጋፍ ያደርጉለት ነበር። የእግር ኳስ ቤተሰቡ እና የቀድሞ ክለቦቹ ለቤተሰቦቻቸው መጽናናትን ተመኝተዋል።
oromo: Abbaan fi bakka bu'aan taphataa kubbaa miillaa beekamaa Lionel Messi kan ta'an Jorge Messi dhukkuba booda umuriin isaanii waggaa 68 tti addunyaa kana irraa du'aan boqotaniiru. Jorge guddinaa fi milkaa'ina ilma isaanii keessatti gahee olaanaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, jalqaba irraa eegalee hanga injifannoo addunyaa irratti gargaarsa guddaa godhaniiru. Hawaasni kubbaa miillaa fi kilaboonni isaan dura itti taphatan maatii Messiif gadda isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Madonna pays tribute to 'genius, otherworldly' producer William Orbit
english: Madonna has shared a heartfelt tribute to her longtime collaborator, the Grammy-winning producer William Orbit, following his recent passing at age 69. She credited him for transforming her artistic direction, particularly during their iconic work on her acclaimed 1998 album, Ray of Light. Madonna described their studio sessions as a transformative and spiritual experience that helped her explore new creative depths.
amharic: ማዶና በ69 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት የተለዩትን የረጅም ጊዜ የሙዚቃ አጋሯንና አምራቹን ዊሊያም ኦርቢትን በማስታወስ ልብ የሚነካ መልዕክት አስተላልፋለች። የፖፕ ንግሥቲቱ በ1998 ዓ.ም 'ሬይ ኦፍ ላይት' የተሰኘውን የተሳካ አልበም በአንድነት በመስራት የሙዚቃ ህይወቷን እንደቀየሩት ገልጻለች። ማዶና ከኦርቢት ጋር በስቱዲዮ ውስጥ ያሳለፉትን ጊዜ እንደ መንፈሳዊ ጉዞ በመቁጠር፣ አብረው የሰሩት ስራ የፈጠራ ችሎታዋን እንዳሳደገው ገልጻለች።
oromo: Maadonnaan guddifachaa fi guddifachaa muuziqaa beekkamaa William Orbit, kan umuriin isaa 69 ta'e du'aan darbuusaa hordofee, yaadannoo cimaa isaa ibsiteetti. Isheenis, keessumaa bara 1998 albamii 'Ray of Light' jedhamu irratti waliin hojjechuun isaanii hojii ishee keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fiduusaa yaadatteetti. Maadonnaan yeroo isaan istuudiyoo keessatti dabarsan akka muuxannoo hafuuraa fi uumamaa guddaatti ilaaluun, obbolummaan isaanii dandeettii uumamaa ishee akka guddise ibsiteetti.

title: Which stars need to shine this season: Real Madrid, Barcelona, Man Utd, PSG
english: As European football leagues prepare for the new season, focus is shifting toward the key players expected to drive their teams to success. Star performers like Arsenal's Declan Rice and Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes remain central to their clubs' strategies due to their impressive statistical contributions. With a relatively quiet transfer window, these established stars will be crucial in determining whether their teams can compete for titles this year.
amharic: የአውሮፓ እግር ኳስ ሊጎች ለአዲሱ የውድድር ዘመን ሲዘጋጁ፣ ትኩረቱ በቡድኖቻቸው ስኬት ላይ ወሳኝ ሚና ይኖራቸዋል ተብሎ በሚጠበቁ ተጫዋቾች ላይ አርፏል። እንደ አርሰናሉ ዴክላን ራይስ እና የማንችስተር ዩናይትዱ ብሩኖ ፈርናንዴዝ ያሉ ኮከብ ተጫዋቾች ባሳዩት አስደናቂ ብቃት ለክለቦቻቸው ስልት ማዕከል ሆነው ቀጥለዋል። የዘንድሮው የዝውውር መስኮት በአንፃራዊነት የተረጋጋ በመሆኑ፣ እነዚህ ልምድ ያላቸው ተጫዋቾች ቡድኖቻቸው ለዋንጫ የሚደረገውን ውድድር እንዲያሸንፉ ወሳኝ ይሆናሉ።
oromo: Liigonnii kubbaa miillaa Awurooppaa waancaa haaraaf yeroo qophaa'aa jiranitti, xiyyeeffannaan taphatoota gurguddoo garee isaanii milkeessuu danda'an irratti godhameera. Taphatoonni akka Declan Rice kan Arsenal fi Bruno Fernandes kan Manchester United gumaacha isaanii kan lakkoofsaan mirkanaa'e irraa kan ka'e qindoomina garee isaanii keessatti bakka guddaa qabu. Gabaan jijjiirraa taphatootaa yeroo kana tasgabbaa'aa waan ta'eef, taphattoonni beekamoon kun gareen isaanii waancaa akka argatuuf murteessoo dha.

title: Opposition MP hurls eggs at Kosovo Prime Minister
english: During a parliamentary session held to organize Kosovo's government after recent elections, an opposition member attacked acting Prime Minister Albin Kurti by throwing eggs at him. This disruptive incident occurred while lawmakers were attempting to establish the new parliament. The act highlights ongoing political tensions within the country's legislative body.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረገው ምርጫ የኮሶቮን መንግስት ለማቋቋም በተካሄደው የፓርላማ ስብሰባ ወቅት፣ አንድ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ አባል ጊዜያዊ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አልቢን ኩርቲ ላይ እንቁላል በመወርወር ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው የፓርላማ አባላት አዲሱን ምክር ቤት ለማዋቀር እየሞከሩ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ክስተቱም በሀገሪቱ የህግ አውጭ አካል ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoo booda mootummaa Kosovoo hundeessuuf yaalii taasifamaa ture irratti, miseensi mormituu tokko muummicha ministeeraa yeroo Albiin Kurtiirratti hanqaaquu darbatee miidheera. Gochi kun kan raawwatame yeroo miseensonni paarlaamaa mana maree haaraa hundeessuuf yaalaa turanitti. Taateen kunis walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa biyyattii keessa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Iran says US must accept ‘irreversible’ Strait of Hormuz order
english: A spokesperson for the Iranian military has declared that new regulations established by Tehran in the Strait of Hormuz are permanent and will not be changed despite American opposition. The official warned that the United States must comply with these measures or face severe consequences that exceed previous challenges. Iran maintains that its position is final and expects the U.S. to accept the current reality in the region.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለፁት በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ የወጡት አዳዲስ ደንቦች የማይቀለበሱ እና በአሜሪካ ተቃውሞ የማይለወጡ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ይህንን ነባራዊ ሁኔታ መቀበል እንዳለባት ካልሆነ ግን ከባድ ዋጋ እንደምትከፍል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ኢራን አቋሟ የጸና እንደሆነ እና አሜሪካ በክልሉ የተፈጠረውን አዲሱን ሁኔታ እንድትቀበል ትጠይቃለች።
oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Iraan akka ibsetti, seeronni haaraa qarqara galaana Hormuz keessatti baafaman kan hin jijjiiramne fi mormii Amerikaa irraa dhufeen kan hin dhaabbanne ta'uu beeksisaniiru. Amerikaan haala jiru kana fudhachuu qabdi, yoo ta'uu baate garuu miidhaa kanaan dura isheen keessa dabarsite caalu akka qunnamtu akeekkachiisaniiru. Iraan haalli kun kan murtaa'e ta'uu fi Amerikaan dhugaa jiru kana akka fudhattu irra deebitee hubachiisteetti.

title: UNRWA has been with me since birth, I cannot imagine a future without it
english: For millions of Palestinian refugees, the UNRWA is far more than just a humanitarian organization, as it has provided essential healthcare, education, and legal documentation for generations. The author describes the agency as a central pillar of their identity and survival since birth, noting that it stepped in to assist their family when they were displaced during the 1948 Nakba. Ongoing political efforts to dismantle the agency in Gaza and East Jerusalem are seen as a severe threat to the basic well-being and documented existence of the Palestinian people.
amharic: ለሚሊዮኖች ለሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ስደተኞች፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ኤጀንሲ (UNRWA) ከመደበኛ የሰብአዊ ድርጅት በላይ በመሆኑ ለትውልዶች አስፈላጊ የጤና፣ የትምህርት እና ህጋዊ ሰነዶችን ሲያቀርብ ቆይቷል። ጸሐፊው ድርጅቱ ከተወለዱበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የማንነታቸው እና የህልውናቸው ዋና መሰረት እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ፤ በተለይም በ1948 የነበረው መፈናቀል ሲያጋጥማቸው ቤተሰባቸውን እንደረዳ ያስታውሳሉ። በአሁኑ ወቅት በጋዛ እና በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም ኤጀንሲውን ለማፍረስ የሚደረጉ የፖለቲካ ጥረቶች ለፍልስጤማውያን መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች እና የህጋዊ ማንነት ማረጋገጫዎች ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሆኑ ተመልክቷል።
oromo: Miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman baqattoota Filisxeemii hundaaf, dhaabbanni UNRWA gargaarsa namoomaa qofa osoo hin taane, tajaajila fayyaa, barnoota fi ragaalee seeraa dhaloota gara dhalootaatti kan dhiyeessu dha. Barreessichi akka ibsetti, dhaabbatichi dhaloota isaanii irraa eegalee eenyummaa fi jireenya isaanii keessatti gahee guddaa kan qabu yoo ta'u, bara 1948 erga buqqa'anii booda maatii isaanii akka gargaare eeru. Amma ammaa magaalaa Gaazaa fi Yerusaalem keessatti dhaabbaticha diiguuf yaaliin godhamaa jiru, jireenyaa fi mirga bu'uuraa ummata Filisxeemii irratti balaa cimaa kan uume akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Lebanon ‘detains’ former al-Assad-era general, weighs handing him to Syria
english: Lebanese authorities have arrested a retired Syrian Major-General, Adel Issa, after he visited the Syrian embassy in Beirut for paperwork. The former official, who had been hiding in Lebanon since the collapse of the Assad regime, is now facing potential extradition back to Syria. Lebanese officials are currently awaiting formal documentation from Damascus before deciding whether to hand him over to face accusations related to his past military service.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ባለሥልጣናት የቀድሞውን የሶሪያ ጄኔራል አዴል ኢሳን በቤሩት በሚገኘው የሶሪያ ኤምባሲ ውስጥ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። የባሽር አል-አሳድ መንግስት ከወደቀ በኋላ በሊባኖስ ተደብቀው የነበሩት ጄኔራሉ፣ አሁን ወደ ሶሪያ የመመለስ እና በወታደራዊ ተግባራቸው ላይ ክስ የመመስረት እድል አላቸው። የሊባኖስ ባለሥልጣናት ጄኔራሉን ወደ ሶሪያ ለማስረከብ ከመወሰናቸው በፊት ከደማስቆ የሚመጣውን መደበኛ የክስ ፋይል በመጠባበቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humni nageenyaa Libaanos  ജനራል Adel Issa kan jedhaman, ergaa hojii garaa garaatiif gara embasii Sooriyaa kan deemanii booda to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Namni kun mootummaan Bashar al-Assad erga kufee booda Libaanos keessa dhokatanii kan turan yoo ta'u, amma gara biyya isaaniitti deebifamanii himata irratti banamuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Qondaaltoonni Libaanos ragaa fi himata mootummaa Sooriyaa irraa dhufu erga ilaalan booda gara biyya isaaniitti isaan erguu fi dhiisuu isaanii murteessuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: UAE says Iran targeted ADNOC tanker in Strait of Hormuz, no casualties
english: The United Arab Emirates has accused Iran's Revolutionary Guard of using a missile to strike an ADNOC oil tanker as it passed through the Strait of Hormuz. While no casualties were reported in this latest incident, officials condemned the act as illegal and a threat to global energy security. This event marks a continuing pattern of attacks on vessels in the vital shipping lane, which regional leaders are now calling on the international community to address.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ የአቡ ዳቢ ብሔራዊ የነዳጅ ኩባንያ (ADNOC) ታንከር ሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን እያቋረጠ ሳለ በኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ሚሳይል እንደተመታ አስታውቃለች። በዚህ ጥቃት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት አልተመዘገበም፣ ሆኖም መንግስት ድርጊቱን ህገወጥ እና ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጾታል። ክስተቱ በስትራቴጂካዊው የባህር መስመር ላይ እየተፈጸሙ ያሉ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች አካል ሲሆን፣ የክልሉ ሀገራት ይህንን ለመከላከል ዓለም አቀፍ ጣልቃ ገብነት እንዲኖር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Emirates Gamtoomani, markaan boba'aa kan Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) ta'e tokko yeroo laga Hormuz qaxxaamuru rukutameera jechuun Iran himateera. Hojiin kun waraana Iran (Revolutionary Guard) kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, lubbuun namootaa akka hin dabre gabaafameera. Mootummoonni naannichaa gocha kana balaaleffachuun, nageenya humna elektirikii addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun daandii galaanaarratti miidhaa irra deddeebi'ee raawwatamu keessaa kan dhihoo ta'ee fi qaamoleen idil-addunyaas xiyyeeffannoo akka kennaniif gaafatameera.

title: Iraq’s Kurdish region wants to stay out of regional conflicts: PM Barzani
english: Kurdistan Regional Government Prime Minister Masrour Barzani has stated that his region aims to remain neutral amid the ongoing conflict between Iran, the US, and Israel. He condemned the hundreds of missile and drone attacks that have damaged regional infrastructure, emphasizing that these assaults are unjustified. Furthermore, Barzani expressed support for the Iraqi government’s initiative to disarm paramilitary groups and ensure that weaponry remains under exclusive state control.
amharic: የኩርዲስታን ክልላዊ መንግስት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር መስሩር ባርዛኒ በኢራን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል መካከል እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ክልላቸው ገለልተኛ ሆኖ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። በክልሉ መሠረተ ልማት ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱትን በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ የሮኬት እና ድሮን ጥቃቶች ያወገዙት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ፣ እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ተቀባይነት የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት ታጣቂ ቡድኖችን ትጥቅ ለማስፈታት እና የጦር መሳሪያዎችን በመንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር ለማድረግ የሚያደርገውን ጥረት እንደሚደግፉ አረጋግጠዋል።

Miidhaa bu'uuraalee misoomaa naannichaa irra gahe hordofee haleellaa rookeetii fi dooniiwwan dhibbootaan lakkaa'amanitti ba'uun, haleellaan kun sababa malee kan raawwatame ta'uu dubbataniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan Iraaq garee hidhattootaa hidhannoo hiikkachiisuu fi meeshaaleen waraanaa to'annoo mootummaa qofa jala akka oolan gochuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru akka deggeran ibsaniiru.

title: Turkey and Saudi Arabia's rocky relations: A brief history
english: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman recently prayed together in Mecca, signaling a significant improvement in their previously strained relations. The two nations, along with Pakistan, have strengthened their ties by signing a historic trilateral defense agreement. This collaboration marks a major shift from their long-standing history of competition and occasional political rifts.
amharic: የቱርኩ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶአን እና የሳዑዲው አልጋ ወራሽ መሐመድ ቢን ሳልማን በቅድስት መካ ከተማ በጋራ በመጸለይ ከዚህ ቀደም የነበረውን ውጥረት የተሞላበት ግንኙነት ማሻሻላቸውን አሳይተዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ከፓኪስታን ጋር በመሆን ታሪካዊ የሆነ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት በመፈራረም አጋርነታቸውን አጠናክረዋል። ይህ ትብብር በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ የነበረውን የፉክክር እና የፖለቲካ አለመግባባት ታሪክ ወደ አዲስ ምዕራፍ የሚቀይር ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Turkii Rajab Xayyib Erdogaan fi aangessaan Sa'udii Mohammed bin Salmaan magaalaa Makkaatti waliin kadhachuun hariiroo isaanii kan kanaan dura ture fooyyessuu isaanii agarsiisaniiru. Biyyoonni lamaan kun biyya Paakistaan waliin ta'uun waliigaltee ittisaa seena qabeessa ta'e tokko mallatteessuun hariiroo isaanii cimsuu danda'aniiru. Walta'iinsi kun, biyyoota lamaan gidduutti ganna dheeraaf turee fi dorgommii akkasumas rakkoo siyaasaa keessa ture gara fuulduraatti jijjiiruuf gumaacha.

title: Saudi Arabia and Qatar condemn Iranian attack on UAE tanker
english: Saudi Arabia and Qatar have strongly denounced Iran for attacking an Emirati oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Both nations labeled the incident a major breach of international law and a direct threat to global maritime security and energy trade. They have demanded that Iran stop these aggressive actions and ensure the waterway remains open for international shipping.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ኳታር በሆርሙዝ የባህር ሰርጥ ላይ በኤሚሬቶች የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን የኢራን ጥቃት አጥብቀው አውግዘዋል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ይህ ድርጊት የአለም አቀፍ ህግን መጣስ እና ለአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መስመሮች ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ኢራን ጥቃቱን እንድታቆም እና የባህር መንገዱ ለነጻ አሰሳ ክፍት እንዲሆን ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Sa’udii Arabiyaa fi Qatar haleellaa Iraan markaba boba’aa kan Emireetotaa irratti naannoo Hormuzitti raawwatte cimsanii balaaleeffataniiru. Iraan gochaa kana akka dhaabdu fi karaa galaanaa sana addunyaaf banaa akka gootu gaafataniiru.

title: Unknown projectile hits vessel near Oman, UKMTO says
english: A ship traveling near the coast of Oman was hit by an unidentified object, causing a fire on the vessel. The crew managed to put out the blaze and remained unharmed. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding this security incident.

oromo: Markabni tokko qarqara galaana Omaan biratti argamu mi’a hin beekamneen rukutamee ibidda kaasee ture. Hojjattoonni markabtichaa ibidda sana dhaamsuu danda’aniiru akkasumas hundi isaanii nagaan jiru. Aangeyyonni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Lionel Messi’s father dies aged 68 after a long illness
english: Jorge Messi, the father of legendary footballer Lionel Messi, has passed away at 68 following a prolonged battle with illness. He died at a medical facility in Rosario, Argentina, surrounded by his family. Throughout Lionel's career, Jorge served as a vital mentor and representative, playing a key role in the sports icon's professional and personal journey.

oromo: Abbaan taphataa kubbaa miilaa beekamaa Liyoonel Mesii, Joorgee Mesii, dhukkubsatanii erga tureen booda umurii waggaa 68tti boqotan. Akka gorsaa fi bakka bu'aa cimaatti, abbaan isaanii kun jireenya kubbaa miilaa Liyoonel Mesii keessatti gahee olaanaa qabu turan.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 28
english: The conflict involving Iran has reached its 28th day of the second phase, marked by a new defense agreement between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey that faces skepticism from Iranian leaders. Meanwhile, Iran and Oman have established a security framework for the Strait of Hormuz. Additionally, clashes between Yemeni government troops and Houthi forces have intensified.

oromo: Waraanni Iran sadarkaa lammaffaa isaa guyyaa 28ffaa irra ga’eera. Kanaan walqabatee, waldhabdeen humnoota mootummaa Yaman fi garee Huutii gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufeera.

title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino denies claims UEFA paid off alleged lover
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has firmly rejected accusations that UEFA paid a woman to cover up an alleged romantic relationship with him during his time as their general secretary. While UEFA confirmed they made a standard departure payment and covered educational expenses for the female employee, they did not substantiate claims of an affair. This scandal adds to the pressure on Infantino, who is currently facing calls for his resignation from certain football associations following separate controversies over his management of FIFA.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በዩኤፋ ዋና ጸሃፊ በነበሩበት ወቅት ከአንዲት ሴት ሰራተኛ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው እና ዩኤፋም ጉዳዩን ለመሸፈን ክፍያ እንደፈጸመ የቀረበባቸውን ክስ አጥብቀው አስተባብለዋል። ዩኤፋ ለሰራተኛዋ የሥራ መልቀቂያ ክፍያ እና የትምህርት ወጪ መሸፈኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የፍቅር ግንኙነት እንደነበረ የሚገልጸውን ክስ ግን አላረጋገጠም። ይህ ክስተት ኢንፋንቲኖ በፊፋ አስተዳደር ላይ በሚያደርጉት ውሳኔዎች ሳቢያ በበርካታ እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ግፊት ውስጥ ባሉበት ወቅት የተከሰተ ተጨማሪ ውዝግብ ነው።

UEFA kaffaltii hojii gadi lakkisuu fi gatii barnootaatiif kaffaluu isaa kan mirkaneesse ta'us, hariiroo jaalalaa jedhame sanarratti garuu waanti ibsame hin jiru. Himatichi kun, Infraantino dhimmoota biroo FIFA keessatti gaggeessan irratti qeeqamanii fi dhiibbaan hojii gadhiisuu irratti mudachaa jiru keessatti kan dabalame dha.

title: Iran deliberates Hormuz arrangement amid uncertain prospects with US
english: Iran and Oman have reached a near-final agreement on maritime routes through the Strait of Hormuz. However, Iranian officials emphasize that the full reopening of this strategic waterway remains conditional on the United States fulfilling prior commitments. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps insists that control of the strait is a matter of national power and has warned the US against interfering in these regional negotiations.

oromo: Iiraan fi Oomaan daandii dooniiwwan handhuura Hormuz keessatti ittiin darban irratti walii galtee irra ga'uuf jedhu.
