title: Netanyahu mulls Saudi, Turkiye, Pakistan pact as Israeli elections loom
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed the Mecca Joint Defence Pact, establishing a military alliance where an attack on one member is considered an attack on all. This development presents a significant challenge to Israel, which is currently weighing its response while approaching upcoming elections. The agreement brings together three major regional powers, complicating Israel's security outlook and regional diplomatic goals.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈራረሙት አዲስ የመከላከያ ስምምነት፣ በአንዱ አባል ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ እንዲቆጠር የሚያስገድድ ነው። ይህ ህብረት እስራኤልን በክልሉ ባላት ተጽዕኖ ላይ ተግዳሮት የደቀነ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትም ከምርጫ በፊት ለዚህ አዲስ የኃይል ሚዛን እንዴት ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ በማጤን ላይ ይገኛል። ስምምነቱ በእስራኤል የደህንነት እቅድ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥ የሚያመጣ ነው ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።

Dhimmi kun hariiroo fi nageenya naannoo sanaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa kan qabu dha.

title: Malaysia seizes container suspected of carrying goods bound for Israel
english: Malaysian authorities recently seized a container at the Port of Tanjung Pelepas due to suspicions that its contents were destined for Israel in violation of national trade laws. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim supported the move, stating that Malaysia will not permit its territory to be used for trade that supports Israel. Officials are currently investigating the shipment to determine if it contains restricted strategic goods, reinforcing the country's commitment to international obligations regarding the Palestinian territories.

oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Maleeshiyaa koonteenara gara Israa'elitti ergamuuf ture tokko buufata doonii Taanjung Peleepaasitti to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Muummeen Ministiraa Anwaar Ibraahiim, Maleeshiyaan daldala Israa'eliin deeggaruufi biyyattii akka daandii darbiinsaatti fayyadamuu akka hin hayyamne ibsaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa qabeenyichi seera daldalaa biyyattii kan cabsu ta'uu fi dhibdee uumamee jiru qulqulleeffachuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiran; tarkaanfiin kunis dirqama idil-addunyaa kan falmii mirga Falasxiin deeggaruuf fudhatameedha.

title: What Pakistan's defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey means for the Middle East
english: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey have signed the 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement,' a new security pact where an attack on one nation is considered an attack on all three. This alliance represents a significant strategic shift, as these powerful nations aim to secure their own interests amid rising instability and conflict in the Middle East. By combining their military and economic strengths, the three countries hope to protect key shipping routes and reduce their reliance on traditional Western security arrangements.
amharic: ፓኪስታን፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እና ቱርክ 'የመካ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት' የተሰኘ አዲስ የፀጥታ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል የሚል አንቀጽ አለው። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ባለው አለመረጋጋት እና ግጭት ሳቢያ እነዚህ ኃያል አገራት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ እና የባህር ንግድ መስመሮችን ለመከላከል ተባብረው ለመስራት ወስነዋል።
oromo: Paakistaan, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Turkiin waliigaltee nageenyaa 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement' jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa tokko irratti miidhaan yoo ga'e akka sadiin irrattis ga'etti fudhatama. waliigalteen kun biyyoonni kunneen giddugaleessa bahaatti rakkoolee fi walitti bu'iinsa uumameef deebii kennuufi nageenya isaanii ofiin eeggachuuf kan qopha'e dha. Guddina diinagdee fi humna waraanaa walitti fiduun, biyyoonni kunneen karaa bishaan irraa fi faayidaa biyyoolessaa isaanii eeggachuu barbaadu.

title: US pledges $1bn support to Colombia as Trump-backed president sworn in
english: The United States has committed $1 billion in security aid to Colombia following the inauguration of President Abelardo de la Espriella. A close ally of Donald Trump, the new leader has vowed to launch an aggressive crackdown on organized crime and drug trafficking rather than pursuing peace negotiations. This shift marks a major rightward turn for the country as the new administration seeks to strengthen military ties with the U.S. and Israel.

oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Kolombiyaa haaraa Abelardo de la Espriella aangoo qabachuu hordofee gargaarsa nageenyaa biiliyoona tokko kan ta'u kennuuf waadaa galeera. Michuu Donald Traamp kan ta'an pirezidaantiin haaraan kun garee yakka raawwatan irratti duula cimaa geggeessuuf karoorfataniiru. Jijjiirraan kun Kolombiyaan gara mirgaatti akka garagalte kan argisiisu yoo ta'u, mootummaan haaraan kun Ameerikaa fi Israa'el wajjin hariiroo waraanaa cimsuuf fedhii qaba.

title: Ivory Coast’s ‘talking drum’ returns to home village after 110 years
english: A sacred musical instrument known as the Djidji Ayokwe has finally returned to its native Ebrie community in Ivory Coast. The drum, which was historically used to communicate important messages and warnings, had been seized by French soldiers over a century ago in 1916. The French government officially handed the artifact back to the village this past February.
amharic: ጂጂ አዮክዌ የሚባል ቅዱስ ከበሮ ከ110 ዓመታት በኋላ ወደ መጣበት የኮትዲቯር የኤብሪ ማህበረሰብ ተመልሷል። ይህ ከበሮ በታሪክ ዘመናት ውስጥ መልዕክቶችን ለማስተላለፍ እና ስለ አደጋዎች ለማስጠንቀቅ ያገለግል የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በ1916 በፈረንሳይ ወታደሮች ተዘርፎ ተወስዶ ነበር። የፈረንሳይ መንግስት ቅርሱኑን በይፋ ለተወላጅ መንደሩ ባለፈው የካቲት ወር አስረክቧል።
oromo: Meeshaan muuziqaa qulqulluun Djidji Ayokwe jedhamu waggoota 110 booda gara biyya isaatti, aanaa ummata Ebrie kan Kootdivuwaaritti deebi'eera. Kunuun kun yeroo darbe ergaa dabarsuufi balaa akeekkachiisuuf gargaaraa ture, bara 1916 waraana Faransaayitti saamamee ture. Mootummaan Faransaay meeshaa kana baatii Guraandhala darbe keessa seeraan gara ganda isaatti deebiseera.

title: Drones spotted in Bulgaria and Germany raise concerns of Russian escalation
english: Recent sightings of unidentified drones near critical infrastructure in Bulgaria and military sites in Germany have sparked alarm across Europe. These incidents, including an explosion near a Bulgarian gas pipeline and unauthorized flights over German defense facilities, have fueled suspicions of Russian interference. As a result, NATO nations are increasingly concerned that the ongoing conflict in Ukraine could expand beyond its borders, prompting urgent discussions regarding national security preparedness.

title: Police bodycam and CCTV catches Idaho mall shooting as it unfolds
english: Newly released video footage from police cameras and security systems has captured a tragic shooting event at an Idaho shopping center. During the incident, a gunman killed three people and wounded several others. The situation ended when the suspect took his own life.

oromo: Suuraa kaameroota poolisii fi kan naga eegdotaa kanneen bakka gabaa Ayidaaho keessatti dhukaasa cimaa raawwatame mul’isan ifoomee jira. Mudannoo kana keessatti namni miila qajeelaa hin qabne tokko namoota sadii yoo ajjeesu, warra biroo hedduus miidheera. Namichi shakkamaa ta’e kun dhukaasa ofii isaatti dhukaasuun lubbuu isaa galaafateera.

title: Atletico Madrid will not sell Alvarez amid Barcelona interest, says Simeone
english: Atletico Madrid manager Diego Simeone has firmly stated that the club has no intention of selling forward Julian Alvarez, despite strong interest from Barcelona and other major European clubs. The club has even filed a complaint with FIFA over Barcelona's pursuit, emphasizing that Alvarez remains a vital part of their future plans. Simeone expressed his desire to support the player's continued development at the team, dismissing any possibility of a transfer regardless of the price offered.

oromo: Leenjisaan Atleetikoo Maadriid Diyegoo Simeeonee, kilabichi taphataa fuula duraa Juuliyaan Alvaareez gurguruuf karoorri tokkollee akka hin jirre ibsaniiru. Giddu galeessa kana keessa baarseenloonafi kilaboonni gurguddoon biroo taphaticha barbaadaa kan jiran ta'us, Atleetikoon garuu gama isaatiin baarseenloon karaa seeraan alaa taphaticha harkisuuf yaalte jechuun FIFA'tti komii dhiyeesseera. Simeeoneen Alvaareez guddina kilabichaaf baay'ee barbaachisaa ta'uu himuun, gatii meeqaatu dhiyaate iyyuu taphaticha gurguruuf fedhii akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru.

title: Arsenal complete signing of Newcastle midfielder Bruno Guimaraes
english: Arsenal has officially acquired Brazilian midfielder Bruno Guimaraes from Newcastle United for approximately $101 million. The 28-year-old signed a four-year contract with an optional extension, bringing his versatile skills to the reigning Premier League champions. This major transfer is expected to bolster Mikel Arteta's squad as they look to defend their domestic title and succeed in European competitions.
amharic: አርሰናል የብራዚላዊውን አማካይ ብሩኖ ጊማሬስን ከኒውካስትል ዩናይትድ በ101 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ግምት ዋጋ በይፋ አስፈርሟል። የ28 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ለአራት ዓመታት የሚቆይ ኮንትራት የተፈራረመ ሲሆን፣ በቡድኑ ውስጥ ባለው ብቃት አርሰናል የሊጉን ዋንጫ ለመከላከል እና በአውሮፓ ውድድሮች ውጤታማ ለመሆን ጠንካራ አቅም እንደሚፈጥርለት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Arsenal taphattoolee giddu galeessa biyya Brazil Bruno Guimaraes qulqulleeffannoo Niwukaastil Yuunaytid irraa doolaara miiliyoona 101tti gurguratee bituun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Umuriin isaa waggaa 28 kan ta'e taphattoon kun waliigaltee waggaa afurii kan mallatteesse yoo ta'u, qophii Arsenaal kan ta'e Mikel Arteta garee isaa cimsuuf fi waancaa Premier League itti fufsiisuuf gargaara jedhamee eegama.

title: ‘Hi friends’: Modi’s curious campaign to win over Gen Z
english: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his political party are launching a new social media initiative targeting younger voters. By sharing casual content on Instagram, they hope to improve their image among Gen Z following recent public protests. This strategy reflects an effort to connect with the younger generation through modern digital platforms.
amharic: የህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ እና የፖለቲካ ፓርቲያቸው ወጣት መራጮችን ለመሳብ አዲስ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ዘመቻ ጀምረዋል። በቅርቡ በተደረጉ ተቃውሞዎች ሳቢያ የወጣቶች ተቀባይነት ለመጨመር በኢንስታግራም አማካኝነት መደበኛ ያልሆኑ ይዘቶችን እየለቀቁ ነው። ይህ አካሄድ ወጣቱ ትውልድ ጋር በዲጂታል መድረኮች ለመቀራረብ የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Indiyaa Naarendiraa Moodii fi paartiin isaanii dargaggoota mormataa ofitti harkisuuf sochii midiyaa hawaasummaa haaraa eegalaniiru. Mormiiwwan darban booda amantii dargaggootaa deebifachuuf, Instagram irratti qabiyyee salphaa fi waliin ta'uu agarsiisu maxxansaa jiru. Adeemsi kun dargaggoota biratti fudhatama argachuuf mala dijitaalaa fayyadamuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: The post-American Middle East is beginning to take shape
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan have signed a landmark mutual defense pact, signaling a shift toward a new security architecture in the Middle East independent of U.S. influence. This alliance unites three of the most influential Sunni Muslim nations, pledging that an attack on one is considered an attack on all. The agreement follows the recent US-Iran conflict, which highlighted the limitations of the existing American military presence in the region. Regional powers are now taking proactive steps to manage their own collective security as American strategic dominance wanes.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን የአሜሪካን ተጽዕኖ ያልተከተለ አዲስ የክልሉ የጸጥታ ማዕቀፍ ለመመስረት የሚያስችል የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በሶስቱ ሀገራት መካከል የሚፈጸም ጥቃት በሁሉም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል የሚል ጠንካራ የጋራ መከላከያ ግዴታን ይዟል። በቅርቡ የተካሄደው የአሜሪካ እና ኢራን ግጭት የአሜሪካን የጸጥታ ዋስትና ውስንነት በማሳየቱ፣ የክልሉ ሀገራት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ ወደዚህ አዲስ የትብብር እርምጃ እንዲገቡ አስገድዷቸዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkii fi Paakistaan harka Amarkaa irraa bilisa ta'eefi nageenya naannichaa eeggachuuf waligaltee ittisa waloo mallatteessaniiru. Waligalteen kun biyyoonni kunneen sadan yoo tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame, kan biroos haleellaa sana akka ofii isaaniitti akka fudhatan dirqama galchuun kan hundaa'e dha. Waraanni Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti dhiheenya kana tureef, humnoonni naannichaa ga'umsa Ameerikaan naannichatti qabdu kan daangaa qabu ta'uu hubachuun, nageenya isaanii ofumaan eeggachuuf tarkaanfii kana fudhataniiru.

title: Families retrieve bodies after deadly shooting rampage outside Bangkok
english: Families have begun collecting the bodies of loved ones following a tragic shooting at a Thai school that left nine people dead, including a 14-year-old gunman who also killed his grandparents. The incident, which occurred near Bangkok, has left sixteen others injured, many of whom are young students currently in critical condition. Authorities are investigating the attack, noting that the weapon used in the rampage was legally registered to the teenager's grandfather.
amharic: ባንኮክ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ ትምህርት ቤት በተፈጸመ አሰቃቂ የተኩስ አደጋ ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ዘጠኝ ሰዎችን አስከሬን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ተረክበዋል። አጥቂው የ14 ዓመት ታዳጊ ሲሆን አያቶቹን ከገደለ በኋላ በትምህርት ቤቱ መምህራን ላይ ተኩሶ በራሱ ህይወት ላይም አጥፍቷል። በአደጋው 16 ሰዎች ቆስለው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ሲሆን፣ ከጉዳዩ ጋር በተያያዘም ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Maatiin namoota miidhaan irra gahe du'a isaanii booda reeffa isaanii fudhachuu jalqabaniiru. Magaalaa Baangkoookitti dargaggeessi waggaa 14 tokko akaakayyuu fi ayyoyyuu isaa erga ajjeese booda mana barnootaatti dhukaasa banuun namoota sagal ajjeeseera. Miidhaan kun namoota biroo 16 irratti gahee kan jiru yoo ta'u, isaan keessaas hedduun isaanii haala baay'ee yaaddessaa keessa jiru.

title: Woman screams for her man as Ukraine war recruiters pounce
english: A viral video from Ukraine shows men being forcibly detained and pushed into a van by military recruiters, a practice often referred to as 'busification.' This aggressive method of conscription has raised significant concerns about human rights and the state's tactics for gathering soldiers. The incident highlights the growing tensions and controversies surrounding military mobilization efforts in the country.
amharic: ዩክሬን ውስጥ ወታደራዊ ምልመላ የሚያካሂዱ ሰዎች ወንዶችን በኃይል ወደ ሚኒባስ ሲያስገቡ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ በስፋት እየተሰራጨ ነው። 'ቡሲፊኬሽን' ተብሎ የሚጠራው ይህ አወዛጋቢ የግዳጅ ምልመላ ስልት፣ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የሰዎች መብት ጥሰት ስጋት ቀስቅሷል። ይህ ክስተት በዩክሬን የጦር ሰራዊት ለመቀላቀል በሚደረገው ጥረት ዙሪያ ያለውን ውጥረት እና ተቃውሞ አመላካች ሆኗል።
oromo: Viidiyoon Yuukireen keessatti namoonni humnaan gara konkolaataa fe'umsaatti butamanii waraanaaf fudhatamaa jiran mul'isu, yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira. 'Busification' jedhamee kan beekamu malli gudeedaan waraana ittiin namoota funaanan kun, mirga namoomaa fi adeemsa mootummaan waraana ittiin gurmeessu irratti gaaffii cimaa kaasee jira. Ta’een kunis sochii waraana Yuukireen keessatti mul’atu irratti mormii fi yaaddoo uumame agarsiisa.

title: Yemen’s collapsing healthcare forces the sick to seek alternative medicines
english: Due to a severe healthcare crisis caused by years of conflict, many people in Yemen are unable to access proper medical treatment and are turning to traditional herbal remedies. This shift often leads to dangerous consequences, as seen with patients who abandon professional medical care for unproven mixtures. Unfortunately, replacing clinical treatments with herbal substitutes frequently results in worsening health conditions and missed opportunities for recovery.
amharic: በየመን ለዓመታት በዘለቀው ግጭት የተነሳ የጤና አገልግሎት በመውደሙ ብዙ ሰዎች ህክምና ማግኘት ተስኗቸው ወደ ባህላዊ ህክምና እየዞሩ ይገኛሉ። እንደነዚህ ያሉ ያልተረጋገጡ የባህል መድኃኒቶች መጠቀም ለታካሚዎች የጤና መታወክ እና ለከፋ ህመም እየዳረጋቸው ነው። ህመምተኞች ዋናውን የህክምና እርዳታ ትተው ወደ እነዚህ አማራጭ ህክምናዎች መሸጋገራቸው አደገኛ የጤና ቀውስ እየፈጠረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Yemen keessatti waraana waggoota hedduuf tureen wal qabatee tajaajilli fayyaa waan hir'ateef, namoonni hedduu yaala ammayyaa argachuu dadhabanii gara qorichaa aadaatti goraa jiru. Qorichoonni aadaa mirkanaa'oo hin taane kun fayyaa namoota irratti miidhaa hamaa geessisaa jira. Dhukkubsattoonni yaala hospitaalaa dhiisanii gara qoricha aadaatti jijjiirachuun isaanii dhibee isaanii daran akka hammaatuufi carraa fayyinaa akka dhaban taasisaa jira.

title: 'Foreign forces must leave': Iran says regional countries can ensure their own security
english: A senior adviser to Iran's supreme leader has demanded the withdrawal of all foreign troops from the region, labeling them as the primary cause of instability. He argued that Middle Eastern nations are capable of maintaining their own security through increased cooperation. Furthermore, he claimed that recent setbacks for American and Israeli interests have strengthened the necessity for these external forces to leave.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ መሪ አማካሪ በክልሉ ውስጥ የሚገኙ የውጭ ኃይሎች ለጸጥታ መደፍረስ ዋና ምክንያት በመሆናቸው በአስቸኳይ መውጣት እንዳለባቸው አስታውቀዋል። የክልሉ አገራት በጋራ በመስራት የራሳቸውን ሰላም ማስጠበቅ እንደሚችሉ የገለጹት አማካሪው፣ የአሜሪካ እና የእስራኤል ተፅዕኖ መቀነስ የውጭ ጦር መውጣትን አስፈላጊነት እንደሚያጎላ ተናግረዋል።

Kana malees, dadhabina Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irratti mul'ateen walqabatee, humnoonni alaa naannicha gadhiisuun murteessaa ta'uu isaa hubachiisaniiru.

title: IRGC says Hormuz reopening depends on US accepting Iran’s terms
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has stated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States agrees to Iran's specific demands. Officials emphasized that this maritime route is a vital element of Iran's national power and security strategy. The government clarified that this issue is independent of any diplomatic negotiations currently taking place with Oman.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እንደገና የሚከፈተው አሜሪካ የኢራንን ሁኔታዎች ስትቀበል ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ባለስልጣናቱ እንደገለፁት ይህ የባህር መስመር የኢራን ስትራቴጂያዊ ኃይል አካል በመሆኑ የከፈተው በልዩ ሁኔታዎች መሠረት ብቻ ነው። ጉዳዩ በአሁኑ ወቅት ከኦማን ጋር እየተካሄደ ካለው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ጋር እንደማይገናኝም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Waraana Iran (IRGC) akka ibsanitti, daandiin galaana Hormuz kan banamu yoo Ameerikaan gaaffiiwwan Iran fudhatte qofa dha. Dhimmi kun marii diippiloomaasii biyyattii Omaan waliin geggeessitu irraa bilisa ta'uu isaas ibsichi ni agarsiisa.

title: 'Used as human bait': Leaked image shows elderly Palestinian men before execution by Israeli forces
english: A recently leaked photograph depicts two elderly Palestinian men, Nadi and Ali Marouf, blindfolded and standing near Israeli soldiers shortly before they were killed in November 2024. Reports indicate that these men were abducted from Beit Lahia and forced to act as human shields by the Israeli military for several days. These allegations of civilians being coerced into dangerous military operations have sparked widespread concern and are classified as violations of international law.
amharic: በቅርቡ የወጣ አንድ ምስል ናዲ እና አሊ ማሩፍ የተባሉ ሁለት አረጋውያን ፍልስጤማውያን በኖቬምበር 2024 ከመገደላቸው ጥቂት ሰዓታት በፊት በዓይናቸው ታፍነው በእስራኤል ወታደሮች መካከል ቆመው ያሳያል። ዘገባዎች እንደሚጠቁሙት እነዚህ ሰዎች ከቤት ላሂያ የተወሰዱ ሲሆን ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ለበርካታ ቀናት የሰው ጋሻ ሆነው እንዲያገለግሉ ተደርገዋል። ንጹሃን ዜጎችን አስገድዶ ወደ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ውስጥ ማስገባት ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እና ከፍተኛ ቁጣን የቀሰቀሰ ድርጊት ነው።
oromo: Suurri dhiheenya kana bahe tokko, namootni umriin isaanii deemaa ta'e Nadii fi Alii Ma'ruuf jedhaman, Sadaasa 2024 keessa ajjeefamuu isaanii dura ijaan hidhamanii waraana Israa'el biratti mul'achuu isaanii argisiisa. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, namootni kunneen Beit Laahiyaa irraa butamanii guyyoota muraasaaf akka gaachana namootatti fayyadamaa turaniiru. Namoota nagaa dirqisiisanii hojii waraanaafi fayyadamuu fi balaa keessa buusuun kun seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu ta'uun isaatiin mormii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Israel has the power to dominate, but not to lead the region
english: Israel possesses significant military might that allows it to exert force and control over its neighbors, but it lacks the political and social influence to achieve true regional leadership. While its technology sector is highly successful, it remains heavily integrated into and dependent on the American system rather than creating independent global authority. Ultimately, Israel's reliance on coercion means it can destroy threats, but it fails to build the consensus or regional integration necessary to lead.
amharic: እስራኤል በወታደራዊ አቅሟ በጎረቤት ሀገራት ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ መፍጠር ብትችልም፣ የክልሉን አመራር ለመያዝ የሚያስችል ፖለቲካዊ እና ማህበራዊ ተቀባይነት የላትም። የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፏ እጅግ የዳበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከራሷ ገለልተኛ በሆነ መንገድ ዓለም አቀፍ ተጽዕኖ ከመፍጠር ይልቅ በአሜሪካ ስርዓት ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። በመሆኑም እስራኤል በጉልበት ትችላለች እንጂ በስምምነት እና በመረዳዳት የክልሉን አገራት መምራት አልቻለችም።
oromo: Israa'el humna waraanaa cimaa qabaachuun biyyoota ollaa ishee irratti dhiibbaa gochuu dandeessi, garuu gaggeessituu naannawaa ta'uuf hayyamaa fi fudhatama siyaasaa hin qabdu. Dameen teeknoolojii ishee milkaa'ina guddaa kan qabu ta'us, akka waan of danda'etti addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu mannaa, guddina ishee guutumatti sirna Ameerikaa irratti hundaa'eera. Walumaagalatti, Israa'el humnaan dirqisiisuu dandeessi malee, waliigaltee fi wal-hubannoon naannicha hoogganuuf hamma ammaatti hin milkoofne.

title: How Israel’s occupation fuels resistance
english: The ongoing Israeli occupation of Palestinian territories is trapped in a dangerous cycle where military control triggers local resistance, which then serves as a pretext for further expansion. A recent escalation near Nablus resulted in the death of five Palestinians following the establishment of four additional illegal outposts. This persistent pattern of violence and settlement expansion continues to destabilize the region.
amharic: በፍልስጤም ግዛቶች ላይ ያለው የእስራኤል ወረራ ወታደራዊ ቁጥጥር ለአካባቢው ተቃውሞ መነሳሳት እንደሚሆን እና ይህም ለበለጠ ወረራ ምክንያት እንደሚሆን በሚያሳይ አደገኛ ዑደት ውስጥ ወድቋል። በናብለስ አቅራቢያ አራት አዳዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎች ከተቋቋሙ በኋላ በተነሳ ግጭት አምስት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው የጥቃት እና የሰፈራ መስፋፋት አካባቢውን ወደለላ ቀውስ እያመራው ይገኛል።
oromo: Qabsoon Israa'el naannolee Falasxiin irratti gootu, to’annoon waraanaa mormii akka kaasu fi mormiin sun immoo sababa biraa ta’ee babal’ina lafaa akka babal’isuu godha. Nablus biratti buufataalee haarawa afur erga dhaabamanii booda, walitti buiinsa uumameen Falasxiinonni shan ajjeefamaniiru. Gochi kun rakkoo nageenyaa fi babal'ina buufataalee waraanaa itti fufiinsaan kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Todd Blanche, Trump's ex-lawyer, confirmed as US attorney general
english: Todd Blanche, formerly Donald Trump’s private attorney, has been officially confirmed as the United States Attorney General following a narrow 50-49 Senate vote. His nomination faced significant opposition from Democrats and some Republicans who expressed concerns regarding his past professional conduct and potential for politicizing the Justice Department. Despite these controversies, Senator Bill Cassidy provided the final supporting vote, allowing Blanche to take over the role permanently after serving as the acting official since April.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የግል ጠበቃ የነበሩት ቶድ ብላንች፣ በሴኔቱ በተካሄደ ጠባብ ድምፅ በ50 ለ49 የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ህግ ሆነው ተሾሙ። ለእጩነታቸው በዴሞክራቶች እና በአንዳንድ ሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ዘንድ ከባድ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸው ነበር፤ ይህም በዋናነት ያለፈውን የስራ ታሪካቸውን እና የፍትህ ሚኒስቴርን ወደ ፖለቲካ የመቀየር አቅም ስላለው ስጋት ነው። እነዚህ አለመግባባቶች ቢኖሩም፣ ሴናተር ቢል ካሲዲ ወሳኙን ድምፅ በመስጠታቸው፣ ብላንች ከሚያዝያ ወር ጀምሮ ሲመሩት የነበረውን ጊዜያዊ ስራ በቋሚነት እንዲረከቡ አስችሏቸዋል።
oromo: Ogeessi seeraa kanaan dura Donald Trump tajaajilaa turan Todd Blanche, sagalee 50 fi 49n Mana Maree Senaatii Ameerikaatiin Abbaa Alangaa Waliigalaa ta'anii mirkanaa'aniiru. Muudamni isaanii gama Paartii Dimokiraataa fi miseensota Senaatii warra Ripabiliikaa muraasaatiin mormii cimaa kan mudate yoo ta'u, kunis hojii isaanii darbee fi waajjira haqaa gara siyaasaatti geessuu danda'u jedhamee sodaatamee ture. Mormiiwwan kun hundi jiraatuyyuu, Senater Biil Kaasidii sagalee murteessaa kennuun isaanii, Blanche ji'a Ebla irraa jalqabee hoogganaa turan sanatti guutumaan guututti akka itti fufan taasiseera.

title: Trump’s former personal lawyer narrowly confirmed as US attorney general
english: The U.S. Senate has narrowly confirmed Todd Blanche, a former personal attorney for President Donald Trump, as the new attorney general. This appointment faced significant criticism due to concerns that Blanche might compromise the Justice Department's historical independence to serve the president’s political agenda. While some Republicans initially questioned his controversial financial and legal actions, Blanche eventually secured approval after promising to revise certain policies.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የቀድሞ የግል ጠበቃ የሆኑትን ቶድ ብላንሽን በአዲሱ የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ዓቃቤ ህግነት በጠባብ ድምፅ አፅድቋል። ብላንች የፍትህ ሚኒስቴርን ገለልተኛነት በመጠበቅ ረገድ ትልቅ ስጋት ይፈጥራሉ በሚል ብዙ ትችቶች ቢሰነዘሩባቸውም፣ የቀረቡላቸውን ተቃውሞዎች በመፍታታቸው ስልጣኑን ተረክበዋል። አንዳንድ የሪፐብሊካን አባላትም የገንዘብ አጠቃቀምን በተመለከተ ስጋት የነበራቸው ቢሆንም፣ የፖሊሲ ማስተካከያ በማድረጋቸው ማፅደቃቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mana maree Ameerikaa (Senate) kan ture Todd Blanche, kan kanaan dura abukaatoo dhuunfaa Donald Trump turan, akka abbaa seeraa guddaa (Attorney General) biyyattii ta'an sagalee muraasaan mirkaneesseera. Muudamni kun, waajjirri haqaa bilisummaa isaa eeggachuu akka hin dandeenyeefi ajandaa siyaasaa dura taa'ichaaf akka hojjetu yaaddoo uumeera. Sagaleen kun mormii hedduu keessa kan darbe yoo ta'u, Blanche hojiiwwan mormii kaasan tokko tokko fooyyessuuf waadaa seenuun isaa muricha akka injifatu isa gargaareera.
